Notes
Comis Hotel & Golf Resort – Santon, Isle of Man
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Hours: Full-Time | Permanent

We are looking for an experienced Spa Manager or a Senior Beauty/Spa Therapist who is ready to take the next step into management to join Comis Hotel & Golf Resort.
This is an excellent opportunity for either an established Spa Manager or an experienced Senior Therapist with strong leadership potential who is looking to progress their career.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate and develop our team of Spa Therapists.
Deliver professional spa treatments to a high technical standard.
Manage bookings, rotas, scheduling and daily spa operations.
Drive treatment, retail and revenue performance.
Monitor costs, targets and departmental KPIs.
Maintain excellent guest service, cleanliness and presentation standards.
Ensure compliance with health & safety and company procedures.
Support the promotion of spa services, offers and social media activity.

About You
NVQ Level 3 Beauty/Spa Therapy qualification or equivalent – essential.
Experience as a Spa Manager, Spa Supervisor or Senior Beauty/Spa Therapist.
Strong practical treatment skills and a passion for wellness and guest care.
Leadership experience or the confidence and ability to take the next step into a management role.
Commercial awareness and the ability to work towards treatment, retail and revenue targets.
Excellent communication, organisation and people skills.
Confident using booking and scheduling systems.
Flexible to work weekends and variable hours as required.
Knowledge of Elemis products would be advantageous.

What We Offer
Competitive salary based on experience.
Service charge participation.
Relocation assistance.
Staff meals and uniform.
Hotel and staff discounts.
Recognition and reward schemes.
Free on-site parking.
Training and career development opportunities.

The opportunity to progress into spa management and develop your leadership career.

To apply, please send your CV and cover letter to HR@comishotel.com.

Applicants must be eligible to work in the Isle of Man.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

STRICTLY NO AGENCIES

Manage project finances from cost-value reconciliations (CVRs) and cash flow forecasts to final accounts.
Value completed works, issue interim valuations, and manage subcontractor payments.
Compile tender packages, measure variations, and negotiate contracts.
Conduct value engineering and risk management to maximise project efficiency.
Build strong relationships with local and off-island suppliers and subcontractors.

3–5+ years’ QS experience with a main contractor or consultancy.

Full clean driving licence.

Competitive salary package.
Private Medical Cover.
Ongoing professional development & qualification support.

Notes
General Construction Operative / Builder - DGC Limited.

DGC Limited is a well-established Isle of Man groundworks and construction contractor with a strong project pipeline and a full management and operational structure behind every job. We are looking for a skilled, time-served builder to join our established site team. This is a role for someone who knows how to build from the foundations up and takes pride in doing it well, backed by the plant, materials, management and workforce needed to deliver each project properly. It would suit an experienced tradesperson - including someone who has previously run their own business - looking for a change of pace and the security of working within a strong, well-resourced team.

The successful candidate will carry out groundwork packages and general construction work across our project portfolio, working as a key member of the site team. Drawing on solid all-round building experience, they will help drive projects forward efficiently and safely, working closely with the management team above them and the operatives alongside and below them.  The individual will be comfortable contributing to both small and large projects, confident in their trade, and focused on getting the job done to a high standard as part of a coordinated team effort.

Candidates should be time-served with strong, hands-on experience across the full build process, from foundations upward. Experience in groundworks is important; drainage knowledge is an advantage but not essential. Experience reading and understanding construction details and drawings is essential. We are looking for practical foresight, sound judgement, and the ability to work well within an established team. A full clean driving licence is required.

For more info, please email your relevant experience to info@dgc.im

Notes
We are looking for an experienced Contracts and Compliance Manager to oversee the commercial and contractual performance of our facilities management and building services contracts.

The role will be responsible for managing the full contract lifecycle, including renewals, extensions, variations and annual price reviews, while ensuring contractual obligations, SLAs, KPIs and payment terms are effectively managed. You will monitor contract profitability, identify areas of commercial risk and ensure scope creep and additional works are appropriately identified, quoted and charged.

You will also oversee PPM delivery and maintenance compliance, ensuring schedules remain aligned with client contracts, asset registers, SFG20 and relevant statutory requirements. This will include monitoring overdue or at-risk PPMs, maintaining accurate records and ensuring appropriate certification and evidence is available to demonstrate compliance.

Working closely with Helpdesk, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Projects and QHSE teams, you will provide clear reporting to management, support client reviews and mobilisations, and identify risks or underperformance, driving appropriate corrective action.

About You

You will have experience within Facilities Management, Building Services or a similar contracted service environment, with strong commercial awareness and an understanding of contract profitability. You will have good knowledge of PPM delivery and maintenance compliance, with experience of SFG20 being advantageous.

Strong organisational, analytical and communication skills are essential, together with the confidence to challenge performance, identify risks and drive improvements.
Find Out More

For more information about Prospero, including our employee benefits and what we can offer you, please visit www.prospero.im.

Notes
The Site Manager will be responsible for overseeing projects from mobilisation through to completion, ensuring works are delivered safely, on programme and to the required standards of quality and workmanship. The role will involve coordinating site activities, subcontractors, suppliers and internal teams, managing site logistics and sequencing, conducting regular inspections and identifying and resolving risks or issues.

You will lead, motivate and support site teams and subcontractors, promoting a positive safety and performance culture while monitoring standards and identifying training and development needs. The role will also involve maintaining effective communication with clients, contractors and other stakeholders, ensuring project records are accurate and contractual, quality and regulatory requirements are met.

A key responsibility will be maintaining high standards of Health & Safety and compliance, including reviewing RAMS and permit-to-work documentation, supporting site audits and investigating incidents, near misses and non-conformances, ensuring appropriate corrective actions are implemented.

About You

You will have demonstrable experience in a Site Management role, ideally within construction, facilities management, maintenance or an M&E environment. A strong interest in Mechanical & Electrical services, together with a willingness to develop your technical knowledge, would be advantageous.

You will have excellent organisational and communication skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities across live projects. A proactive approach to problem-solving and decision-making is essential, together with the ability to work independently and recognise when issues need to be escalated.

Qualifications

A full Isle of Man or UK driving licence and IOSH Managing Safely certification are essential, along with a good understanding of Isle of Man health and safety requirements and construction regulations.

SMSTS/SSSTS, First Aid at Work, a CSCS Manager/Supervisor Card, and relevant construction, civil engineering or building services qualifications (NVQ, HNC/HND, Degree or equivalent) are desirable. Proficiency in Microsoft Office is also advantageous.

For more information about Prospero, including our employee benefits and what we can offer you, please visit www.prospero.im.
Interested?  Please send your CV to hr@prospero.im

Notes
LVW Law Limited is seeking a Legal Research Assistant to join our busy and friendly legal practice in Port Erin.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong interest in law who enjoys research, analysing information and producing clear, accurate written work.

The successful candidate will provide research support to the firm and its lawyers across a range of legal matters. Duties will include:

Conducting legal research across a variety of areas of law;
Researching Isle of Man legislation, Rules of Court, case law and other legal authorities;
Assisting with the preparation of legal arguments, opinions, correspondence and Court documents;
Reviewing and summarising legislation, judgments and other legal materials;
Identifying relevant authorities and presenting research findings clearly and concisely;
Assisting with the preparation of case files, bundles and other legal documentation;
Keeping up to date with developments in legislation, case law and legal procedure;
Providing general support to the legal team as required.

We are looking for someone who is:

Highly organised and able to manage competing priorities;
An excellent researcher with strong attention to detail;
Confident reading and interpreting legal material;
Able to analyse information and identify the key issues;
A strong written and verbal communicator;
Comfortable working independently while also being part of a team;
Discreet and professional when dealing with confidential information;
IT literate and able to learn and use legal research and case management systems.

A law degree, legal qualification or previous experience within a legal environment would be advantageous, although applications from candidates with relevant research, academic or professional experience will also be considered.

To apply, please send your CV together with a covering letter outlining your experience to stacey@lvwlaw.com

We’re looking for an experienced and motivated fitness coach to join the team at FitBody Fitness, delivering high-quality small group personal training sessions to our members.

The main focus of the role is coaching small groups through structured, progressive programming, making sure every client trains safely, stays motivated, and keeps moving towards their goals session after session. You’ll also be responsible for inducting new members, taking them through their initial assessments, and helping them settle in so they feel confident and supported from day one.

Just as important is the work that happens between sessions, with regular check-ins to keep clients accountable on their training, nutrition, and lifestyle, building the kind of relationships that keep people engaged and coming back.

The ideal candidate holds a recognised Level 3 personal training qualification, has genuine experience coaching groups rather than only one-to-one, and brings the energy, reliability, and communication skills needed to lead a room full of different abilities. You’ll need to be organised, personable, and genuinely invested in getting results for the people you coach.
To apply, send your CV along with a short note about your coaching experience and why you’d be a good fit for FitBody Fitness to fitbodyfitness.im@hotmail.com.

Notes
Mencap Isle of Man has been at the heart of the Island’s learning disability community for decades - creating opportunities, championing inclusion and helping people live more connected, independent and fulfilling lives.

At the heart of their work is a vibrant and welcoming community - bringing people together, building confidence and connections, and creating opportunities to participate, belong and thrive.  From activities and family support to advocacy and shaping better services, their work has a real and lasting impact across the Island.

Joining Mencap means becoming part of a small, committed team with a big sense of purpose, where your ideas, energy and contribution really matter.

Keep things moving.  Make things better. Be part of something that matters.
This is a key role at the heart of Manx Mencap, providing the operational backbone that helps the charity and its people do their best work.

Varied and hands-on, you’ll coordinate day-to-day operations and administration, support the Board and governance processes, maintain systems and records, and provide practical support across people, fundraising, communications and events. 

You’ll also have the opportunity to improve processes and help shape how the charity operates as it moves forward.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

Strong administration or operational support experience

Excellent organisation and the ability to juggle competing priorities

Experience with databases/CRM systems and confidence with Microsoft Office

Experience supporting formal meetings, including agendas and minute taking

Confidence communicating with trustees, senior stakeholders and external organisations

A proactive, practical approach — spotting what needs doing and making it happen

Above all, a genuine connection with Manx Mencap’s purpose and the people it supports

Experience within the third sector or healthcare, fundraising and events, digital content or policy and procedure development would be an advantage.

This could be a great opportunity for an experienced administrator or operations professional who wants more ownership, variety and purpose in their next role.

Find out more here - https://www.paragon.co.im/careers/32635/index0/Senior-Operations-Support-Officer-Permanent-Job-Isle-Man-Permanent-Isle-Man-Pp22839

Slade Scaffolding Limited is looking for a reliable, hardworking and enthusiastic person to join our team in this varied and hands-on role. If you enjoy working outdoors, being part of a team and want the opportunity to learn a skilled trade, this could be the job for you! The role involves driving our 7.5 tonne wagon to and from sites, delivering and collecting scaffolding equipment, loading and unloading materials and assisting our experienced scaffolders with the erection and dismantling of scaffolding. A 7.5 tonne driving licence is essential for this position. Previous scaffolding experience is not essential, as full training will be provided to the right person, including the opportunity to undertake recognised scaffolding training courses and develop your skills within the company. We offer an attractive package including an attendance bonus for excellent attendance and punctuality, additional bonus payments at TT and Christmas. The successful applicant will need to be physically fit, dependable, punctual, safety-conscious and willing to work as part of a team. With the role involving outdoor manual work in all weather conditions. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude and a genuine willingness to learn, who wants to become part of a friendly and established local company. If you have your 7.5 tonne licence, a good work ethic and are ready for a new opportunity, we would love to hear from you! For more details and to apply send your CV and a covering letter to tracy@sladescaffolding.im

Notes
One Island Taxi is growing, and we're looking for licensed Taxi and Private Hire drivers across the Isle of Man to join our expanding driver network.

Following our public launch, we're already seeing bookings across Douglas and increasing demand in the South, West and North of the Island. We're looking for additional licensed drivers to help us improve coverage Island-wide.

One Island gives drivers an additional source of bookings while allowing them to retain their independence and flexibility. There is no monthly subscription, no joining fee and no exclusivity. You decide when you're available and only pay commission on bookings generated through One Island.

Introductory commercial model:

Month 1: 0% commission.
Month 2: 5% commission.
Month 3 onwards: 10% on the first £4,400 of monthly One Island earnings, reducing to 5% above £4,400.

You can continue working independently or with an existing Taxi or Private Hire operator. One Island simply provides another way for customers to find and book you when you're available.

Notes
Due to continued growth and the successful award of several new contracts, we are seeking experienced and motivated Electrical Engineers to join our expanding team. The successful candidates will undertake a varied role covering both planned maintenance and project installation works across a range of commercial and multi-site environments. Duties will include carrying out Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) in line with scheduled programmes, responding promptly and effectively to reactive maintenance issues, and delivering electrical installations on both small and large-scale projects. The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times. Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience. Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position. Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities. Why Join Prospero Group? We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave. Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us. To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

Notes
We are hiring two Software Engineers.

Phantom Studios (Phantom Ltd) is the Isle of Man software studio behind PhantomTrace and our KYC AI platform. We work alongside our sister companies Advantyx (forensic accounting) and Odin Fiduciaries (corporate services). We build software for forensics, KYC and compliance, and fraud work, and we also take on software work for eGaming companies. This is a small team, so what you build ships and gets used.

Both posts are the same role. We are growing the engineering side and there is more work than one person can carry. You will own projects, not tickets. You take something from a rough idea to a running thing people rely on, and you keep it running.

We build with AI agents every day. Claude Code is central to how we work, so this role sits right in the middle of that.

What you'll do:

Build and own some of our projects end to end: backend, deployment, and the day-to-day of keeping them healthy.
Design systems that are simple to run and simple for the next person to read.
Work with AI agents as a normal part of how you build, and know when to trust them and when not to.
Integrate with third-party services (KYC providers, payment and gaming platforms, forensic data sources).
Pick up whatever the project needs, including bits of frontend, data work, and infrastructure.

What you need:

Strong backend engineering in at least one language, and the sense to pick the right tool rather than the familiar one.
Cloud and deployment. You can put a service into production and look after it, not just write the code.
Solid grounding in system design and engineering principles. You think about failure, data, and maintenance before you think about frameworks.
Fluent with agentic development. You have built real things with coding agents (Claude Code or similar) and you understand context management, skills and subagents, prompting, and orchestration. You have a view on where they help and where they get in the way.
API design and integration. Clean interfaces, sensible contracts, third-party services wired in without drama.

Nice to have:

Enough frontend and UI sense to build a decent interface, even if you are not a frontend specialist.
Comfortable across several languages, for example Python, Go, or Java, and happy to pick up whatever a project calls for.
Application security, and care when handling sensitive data.
Any exposure to forensics, compliance, fraud, or eGaming. Not required, we will teach the domain.

Design systems that are simple to run and simple for the next person to read.
Work with AI agents as a normal part of how you build, and know when to trust them and when not to.
Integrate with third-party services (KYC providers, payment and gaming platforms, forensic data sources).
Pick up whatever the project needs, including bits of frontend, data work, and infrastructure.

What you need:

Strong backend engineering in at least one language, and the sense to pick the right tool rather than the familiar one.
Cloud and deployment. You can put a service into production and look after it, not just write the code.
Solid grounding in system design and engineering principles. You think about failure, data, and maintenance before you think about frameworks.
Fluent with agentic development. You have built real things with coding agents (Claude Code or similar) and you understand context management, skills and subagents, prompting, and orchestration. You have a view on where they help and where they get in the way.
API design and integration. Clean interfaces, sensible contracts, third-party services wired in without drama.

Nice to have:

Enough frontend and UI sense to build a decent interface, even if you are not a frontend specialist.
Comfortable across several languages, for example Python, Go, or Java, and happy to pick up whatever a project calls for.
Application security, and care when handling sensitive data.
Any exposure to forensics, compliance, fraud, or eGaming. Not required, we will teach the domain.

Able to read engineering drawings, layouts and stage drawings.
Familiar with air gauging, bore micrometers, diatest etc.
Have a high level of manual dexterity and good hand to eye coordination.

Be able to understand and work to process specifications.
Have a methodical approach to work.
Show flexibility with regard to working hours including working overtime where required.
Have a positive attitude towards Health and safety.
Be able to work both independently and part of a team.

Experience completing FAI to BS9102 using Visual FAIR software.
Previous experience of Engineering Quality aspects and implementation.
Ability to perform first principle measurement.

Competencies:
Key Behavioural Competencies – Tenacious, self motivated, influential. 
Key Personal Indicators – Interpersonal astuteness, persistence and persuasive communication.

Swagelok Ltd

Tool Maker (Twilight Shift)

We are Hiring!

We are looking for an experienced Tool Maker on our twilight shift

Twilight shift (11 am – 21.00 pm working Monday to Thursday)

Toolmaker (Manual Machining & Tool Regrinding)

We are seeking a skilled and self-motivated Toolmaker with a strong background in manual machining and tool reconditioning. This role is focused on precision work using manual lathes and milling machines, alongside surface grinding, tool regrinding, and heat treatment processes.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship and the ability to interpret engineering drawings accurately, while engaging proactively with internal customers to deliver practical, high-quality solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Manufacture, modify, and repair tooling using manual lathes, milling machines, and grinders.
Independently, re-grind a wide range of cutting tools, including drills, reamers, and similar end-working tools, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround.
Perform heat treatment processes as required to support tooling performance and longevity.
Carry out maintenance repairs to jigs, make new fixtures, gauges, and other tooling.
Set up and operate all relevant machine tools and equipment safely and efficiently.
Read and interpret technical drawings and specifications with a high degree of accuracy.
Apply problem-solving skills to identify and resolve non-routine tooling or machining issues.
Work collaboratively with customers and colleagues to develop practical and cost-effective solutions.
Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on experience in traditional toolmaking, with a focus on manual machining processes.
Proven ability to re-grind and restore a variety of cutting tools independently.
Competence in surface grinding and heat treatment techniques.
Excellent understanding of engineering drawings, tolerances, and materials.
Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining high standards.
Effective communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
Additional Requirements

Adheres to all plant regulatory and safety requirements.
Supports the company operating plan and aligns with Swagelok’s mission, vision, and values.
About You

This opportunity is ideal for a dedicated professional who takes pride in their work, thrives in a team environment, and consistently delivers high standards in customer service, quality, and cost-effectiveness.

To apply please visit our recruitment portal at http://iomjobs.swagelok.com

Swagelok Ltd.
Maintenance Housekeeper.
Swagelok is a global engineering company, manufacturing a wide range of high-quality components to a world market, which offers a competitive benefits package for all employees.
Due to continued growth in our Isle of Man site, we are looking for a maintenance housekeeper to join our facilities and maintenance department.
The successful candidates will be responsible for following the company’s general housekeeping and safety practices & policies. They will also be required to independently identify and perform general cleaning for their areas of responsibility.
Additional tasks include supporting our maintenance technicians with general upkeep of our facility including CNC machining centres, assisting with machine moves and installation of new equipment.
As a customer facing site, we require the successful candidate to show close attention to detail, to take pride in their work and ensure a high standard is maintained in all aspects of their roll.
It is preferred that the applicant; holds a counterbalance forklift licence, has experience with food & hygiene in the workplace and is manual handling trained.
The roll can be physical demanding and an applicant must be capable of being on their feet for up to 8- hours a day. Lift, push, pull or carry weight no more than 35lbs, as well as squat bend and reach.
This exciting opportunity would suit an individual who thrives in a team environment, whilst achieving high standards of customer service, quality, and cost effectiveness.
If you are interested in applying for this role, please visit our online portal at http://iomjobs.Swagelok.com

The successful candidate will have already operated at a senior level within a complex multinational environment and will bring a demonstrable track record of leading accounting functions, managing audit relationships, and driving compliance standards across multiple entities. The role carries one direct report and functional oversight responsibility for all regional accounting, control, and compliance teams across the Group. Key Skills and Experience: ACA (Institute of Chartered Accountants in England & Wales), CA (SA) (South African Institute of Chartered Accountants), or CPA (US Certified Public Accountant) - these are the benchmark qualifications for this role and represent a near non-negotiable requirement. CPA qualification preferred but CA/ACA would be considered if you have the above.**

The role: 
The Senior Digital Marketing Executive will provide support for the Markets and Marketing function as well as the wider CDs firm. The ideal candidate should be diligent and well-versed running social media campaign and assisting in maintaining and updating the Crown Dependencies website. The candidate should also be familiar with design software, such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign. The person should have the ability to plan, execute and manage timelines excellently. The role will require communication to stakeholders at all levels.

Accountabilities:
Support the team with campaign production and execution where needed, from global thought leadership to local events.
Create emails to be distributed internally and externally.
General administration which might include helping event suppliers with invoices, managing the job tracker, managing data into our CRM system, manage email queries regarding events.
Assist with eMarketing, including use of our CRM system and sending emails externally.
Maintain and update the local Crown Dependencies website. This includes liaising with other departments to ensure that the information included is accurate to the services they provide.
Act as creative lead for the marketing team – includes overseeing design work done by other members of the team and ensure brand guideline compliance.
Creating and scheduling social media content for LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram posts that are in line with our brand guidelines and in terms of imagery and tone of voice.
Develop and manage social media campaigns, both organic and paid.
Efficiently analyse the performance of both social media and the website to inform decision-making of future digital marketing activities.
Provide training to other departments within the firm to ensure brand compliance of documents that are sent to clients / external stakeholders.
Other marketing tasks may be included as the candidate becomes familiar with the working environment and team.

Candidate requirements:
Ideally hold CIM professional qualification or equivalent, or have studied some sort of marketing, and/ or 4-5yrs experience working in a marketing role.
Strong networking and presentation skills.
Excellent experience running digital marketing campaigns.
Previous experience with Adobe software is advantageous.
An ability to express views and ideas articulately, from both a written and oral perspective.
Confident and independent personal skills.
Ability to multi-task, prioritise workloads and meet agreed timeframes.

Our client seeks a Client Bookkeeper to join their team. This role offers an excellent opportunity to work within a sophisticated, director-led environment, supporting the financial administration of discerning private clients. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining comprehensive financial records, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and facilitating the production of high-quality financial reporting. Key Responsibilities: Ensuring all entities have accounting ledgers set up on Viewpoint or relevant accounting systems.Maintaining consistency with central chart of accounts and obtaining approval for any changes.Processing purchase and sales invoices for client accounting purposes. Posting bank entries through manual entry or upload processes.Reconciling customer receipts, supplier payments and bank statements.Processing monthly journals and accruals as required. Reviewing ledger accounts to ensure readiness for year-end statement preparation.Preparing year-end journals and accounts files for Financial Statement preparation. Engaging with client administrators regarding accounting queries.Preparing VAT returns and ensuring timely submission.Preparing client bank reconciliations for review.Producing management accounts and aged debtor/creditor lists.Completing time billing system entries on a daily basis. Preparing minutes to approve tax returns and Financial Statements. Drafting simple financial statements where required. Key Skills and Experience: Relevant qualification (CAT/AAT) or demonstrable willingness to study .Minimum 3 years; relevant experience in CSP or related environment.Knowledge and experience of accounting software systems, particularly Viewpoint and Xero.Proven experience processing invoices, reconciling accounts and maintaining accounting ledger systems. Understanding of relevant legislation and regulation of financial accounts administration.Strong IT skills including Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel. Excellent numerical, analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16732

Notes
We are looking for a results focused Manager to join our Restructuring Advisory team at FRP Advisory (Isle of Man) Ltd. You will work on a wide range of assignments across both advisory and formal engagements. You will take a lead role in managing a portfolio of insolvency cases, including, liquidations, receiverships, CVL’s and MVL’s ensuring statutory compliance whilst being responsible for stakeholder engagement throughout. You will manage a portfolio of insolvency cases, overseeing case progression from appointment through to closure while ensuring compliance with relevant insolvency legislation. 
The role requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and lead teams across concurrent projects, delegating work effectively, reviewing outputs, and providing technical guidance where required. You will liaise with a range of stakeholders including directors, creditors, legal advisors, accountants and agents, undertake investigations into financial and legal matters, and prepare high-quality reports and presentations for both internal and external audiences. 
In addition, you will support the development of team members, contribute to training initiatives, process improvements and technical updates, and apply strong analytical, problem-solving and commercial skills to identify risks, develop practical solutions and recognise opportunities to support client needs and business growth. A balance of strategic thinking, attention to detail and strong leadership capability will be essential for success in the role. 
We are looking for a degree-educated professional who holds a recognised accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA or ICAS, and has demonstrable experience managing insolvency and advisory cases. The successful candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of insolvency legislation and procedures, coupled with excellent report-writing and communication skills. They will be commercially aware, able to identify opportunities and understand client needs, while also being capable of managing competing priorities and delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, analytical approach and the ability to exercise sound judgement under pressure are essential. You can apply to the role using this link: https://smrtr.io/zZV-x

Hours: 30 hours per week, generally Monday to Friday.
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience.

We are looking for an experienced and detail-focused Accounts Assistant to join our Finance team.
Reporting to the Financial Controller, you will support the day-to-day financial operations of the business, including bank reconciliations, purchase ledger, supplier payments and maintaining accurate accounting records.

Key Responsibilities
Daily bank and system reconciliations.
Processing supplier invoices and reconciling supplier accounts.
Preparing weekly and monthly payment batches.
Investigating cash and card variances.
Maintaining control accounts and finance spreadsheets.
Preparing journals and posting accounting entries.
Ensuring financial controls and procedures are followed.

About You
Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, bookkeeping or similar finance role.
Strong bookkeeping and reconciliation experience.
Sound knowledge of accounting principles and VAT.
Excellent numerical skills and attention to detail.
Good Microsoft Excel skills.
Experience using accounting software; Sage Intacct would be advantageous.
Able to work independently and as part of a small team.

What We Offer
Competitive salary.
30-hour working week, generally Monday to Friday.
Hotel discounts.
Staff meals and uniform.
Service charge participation.
Free on-site parking.
Training and development opportunities.

To apply, please send your CV to HR@comishotel.com.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the Isle of Man or UK. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Strictly no agencies.

Join a dynamic and growing corporate service provider as a Client Accountant. Assist with preparation of financial statements in compliance with FRS 102. Have an understanding and oversight of junior team member's tasks. Budget Analysis. Strong background in financial reporting, management accounts, and budget variance analysis. Familiar with FRS 102. Notes
We are seeking experienced Finance Manager to lead the financial operations of a portfolio of more than 50 companies across the Isle of Man and the UK. 
The group primarily operates within property development, investment and rental management. Candidates must therefore have substantial financial experience in property development, property investment, or residential/commercial rentals.
Key responsibilities
Lead the day-to-day finance function across a multi-company group.
Oversee rental income, arrears, deposits and service charges.
Manage VAT, CIS, statutory and tax filing requirements.
Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll and general ledger activities.
Produce accurate financial and management reporting.
Lead, develop and mentor the finance team.
About you
You will be ACA, ACCA, or an equivalent qualification, with strong experience in property finance, financial management, and reporting. You will also have excellent analytical, organisational and communication skills, advanced Excel capability and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Knowledge of Isle of Man regulatory and corporate compliance requirements is essential. Experience using VT+ or Xero would be advantageous.
Benefits
20 days’ annual leave plus Isle of Man public holidays.
Free access to the onsite gym.
To apply, please submit your CV together with a covering letter outlining your relevant property finance experience to hr@efb.im

Notes
This role provides accounting and financial reporting services to a portfolio of clients, preparing periodic financial statements in line with relevant accounting and industry standards while offering guidance on accounting matters and liaising with stakeholders, external accountants and auditors. 

Key responsibilities include managing the recording of financial information and preparing financial statements for an allocated portfolio of entities on a timely basis and in accordance with jurisdictional client accounting policies, maintaining accurate day-to-day client ledgers across complex, multi-currency transactions using Oak's accounting software (Viewpoint), and keeping meticulous records of bank statements, agreements, invoices and contracts. 

The role also involves liaising with the Administration Team on account queries, preparing annual financial statements, solvency tests, asset statements and other ad-hoc reporting to meet tax return and annual filing deadlines, and preparing tax returns for UK property holdings with HMRC as well as IOM and other relevant tax returns. The successful candidate will provide first-line technical support to the accounting team, stay abreast of changes in the financial, legal and regulatory landscape, and consistently meet internal deadlines with a high level of accuracy using accounting software and MS Excel. 

Candidates should hold a relevant qualification (e.g. ACCA) or have at least three years' experience in a similar role, ideally with fiduciary experience across company and trust structures, alongside strong verbal and written communication skills, an enquiring and proactive mindset, excellent organisational skills, intermediate-or-higher Excel proficiency, adaptability across bespoke IT and banking systems, and the ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines and handle complex issues as a committed team player.

For more details and to apply contact info@ambitions.co.im or 01624 614841.

Notes
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join our newly formed Isle of Man team. This role focuses on maintaining accurate financial records, managing day-to-day transactions, and ensuring compliance across a group of trading companies. 
Reporting directly to the Accounts Manager the successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the finance function, delivering timely reconciliations, and enabling informed decision-making.
Primary responsibilities: Maintain accurate financial records for three active trading companies, ensuring all entries are complete and compliant with internal policies and relevant accounting standards. Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations, resolving discrepancies promptly. Process accounts payable and receivable, ensuring timely supplier payments and accurate client invoicing. Prepare and post journals for accruals, prepayments, and other adjustments. Manage intercompany transactions, reconciliations, and currency transfers. Support month-end and year-end close processes, including the preparation of management accounts and reports for the Financial Director. Assist with VAT and other statutory filings, liaising with external advisors as necessary. Monitor cash flow and provide forecasts to support operational planning. Maintain organised digital and physical financial documentation. Support internal and external audit requirements by providing accurate records and explanations.
Key competencies and behaviours: CAT qualified (or equivalent) or working towards a recognised accounting qualification, with potential support for ACCA study if desired. Proven accounting experience, ideally across multiple trading companies or group structures. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, reconciliations, and financial reporting. Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively across teams and with external partners. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
To apply, please send your CV to grant.cairney@brightsideserv.com. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the Isle of Man or UK as Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What you’ll be doing: 

We're on a journey to build the bank of the future, and we need your help.  We're committed to Help Britain Prosper and become the best bank for customers. As part of this, we're redefining our digital capability, providing customers with simpler, continuous interactions across our digital services – online and mobile. We’re continuing our extensive transformation programme, redefining what a bank is from the inside out.

The purpose of the Product Owner is the overall ownership for a single product backlog spanning multiple delivery channels/ feature teams.  Reporting into the Crown Dependencies Lab Product Owner,  this role is responsible to oversee the release of incremental value within an overall product, with the primary aim of delivering value to customers and stakeholders by ensuring the team focuses on the right priorities.

Please note* This role is based in Jersey or Isle of Man, you’ll require the right to work and live in these locations.

Key Responsibilities

Supports development of Lab or Team OKRs and provides product performance and benefits realisation data.

Oversees the shaping of user-stories to meet customer needs.

Manages Customer Journey Managers and Integrators in the  analysis and prioritisation of  user stories for customer journey improvements.

Shapes Product vision and roadmap, lining into the overarching Lab goals and objectives.

Prioritises, refines and manages Product backlog.

Accountable for Product change governance (e.g., CMIA / SPFIA) and Business Readiness activities (e.g., training and comms, testing and readiness for implementation) for their respective features, journeys or technology components. Note: PO’s are accountable but activities to be delivered by the whole ‘team’.

Plays a role in developing capabilities within their functional area and invests in personal and team growth through mentoring and other informal methods.

Works with Integrators when change is particularly large.

Our client seeks a Part-Time - Accountant to join their team. (Between 25 to 30 hours per week - Flexible) Role Profile Forming part of an experienced team at a small Office, the successful applicant will take day to day responsibility for a number of companies and trusts and various reporting processes, in addition to the compilation of management accounts on a quarterly basis. Preparation of annual financial statements may also be required, however guidance in this area will be provided where necessary. Key Responsibilities. The primary objective of the role will be to work within the accounting team to ensure the requisite accounting and administrative processes are completed for a small number of companies and trusts. Processing of payments and liaising with banks accordingly. Bank reconciliations. Investment reconciliations and liaising with banks/asset managers accordingly. Processing of day to day transactional accounting entries. Processing of month/quarter end accounting journals. Processing bespoke daily and weekly reporting such as investment reports. Preparation of month/quarter end management accounts. Preparation of annual financial statements. Assisting with external audit queries. Preparation of Isle of Man corporation tax returns. Other relevant projects from time to time as required. Provide cover for other members of the team during times of holiday and illness. Key Skills and Experience have experience of day to day journal entries, bank reconciliations, payments, accruals, prepayments, supplier control accounts. have experience in the preparation of management accounts and financial statements for Isle of Man Companies. Knowledge of the Paxus fund accounting system (primary accounting system used) and Sage accounts would be an advantage, but not essential as training will be provided. The successful candidate will be joining a small team supported by the Directors. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16808

Are you a confident, values-led finance professional who would like to use your expertise to make a real difference in the Isle of Man community? Hospice Isle of Man is looking for an enthusiastic and capable Financial Controller to lead our finance function and help support the long-term sustainability of our much-loved charity.
This is a fantastic opportunity to play a key role at the heart of Hospice, providing clear financial leadership, insight and advice to support our Chief Executive Officer, Senior Leadership Team, Board and colleagues across the organisation. You will oversee the day-to-day finance function across Hospice Care, Share the Care and Hospice Properties Limited, ensuring our financial systems, reporting, controls, payroll and audit processes are accurate, effective and well managed.
We are looking for someone who combines strong technical finance skills with warmth, integrity and a collaborative approach. You will be comfortable preparing management accounts, budgets, forecasts and Board-level reports, while also supporting colleagues to understand and use financial information confidently. You will line manage and develop a small finance team, promote good governance and controls, and help us continue to improve the way financial information supports decision-making across Hospice.
In return, you will be joining a compassionate, committed and ambitious organisation where your work will directly contribute to the care and support, we provide for patients, families and the wider community. If you are organised, solutions-focused, professionally curious and motivated by purpose, we would love to hear from you.

For an informal discussion please contact:
Fiona Hatton, CEO on 01624 647444 or 07624 316247

For details of how to apply for this vacancy please visit our website:
www.hospice.org.im/about-us/current-vacancies/

To provide independent second-line oversight, challenge, and insight across Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), Fraud Risk, and Transaction Execution Risk, ensuring material risks are effectively identified, managed, monitored, and reported. The role supports the business in maintaining a strong control environment, drives data-led risk interventions, and provides meaningful risk insights to enable informed decision-making, operational resilience, and positive client outcomes.
Risk Oversight and Challenge
Provide independent oversight and challenge across TPRM, Fraud Risk, and Transaction Execution Risk.
Assess the effectiveness of first-line controls and ensure risks are managed within approved appetite and policy requirements.
Risk Monitoring and Insights
Monitor key risk indicators, incidents, emerging threats, control weaknesses, and industry developments.
Deliver data-driven analysis and actionable insights to support timely risk management interventions.
Third Party Risk Management
Oversee adherence to the Third-Party Risk Management Framework across the third-party lifecycle.
Review material third-party engagements, identify emerging risks and themes, and escalate concerns through appropriate governance structures.
Fraud Risk Management
Act as the primary Non-Financial Risk partner for fraud risk, providing oversight of fraud trends, control effectiveness, incident management, and remediation activities.
Support the development of proactive fraud risk management practices across business units and channels.
Governance, Reporting and Stakeholder Management

About Us:

Woodbourne Dental is a modern and well-established dental practice in Douglas, Isle of Man, committed to providing top-quality dental care in a friendly and professional environment. We are seeking a dedicated and organized Dental Nurse to join our team.

Job Purpose

To provide chairside support to dental professionals while delivering excellent patient care and progressing towards a recognized dental nursing qualification.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the dentist during a variety of treatments, including routine check-ups, fillings, and surgical procedures.
Set up and clean down surgeries before and after each patient in accordance with infection prevention and control protocols.
Ensure all equipment is sterilized and safe for use, following infection control procedures.
Prepare and maintain the clinical environment, including instruments and materials.
Perform intraoral scanning under supervision, aiding with digital impressions and workflow for orthodontic, restorative, or cosmetic treatments.
Deliver excellent patient care and support, ensuring a comfortable and welcoming experience.
Accurately record patient details, procedures, and notes as directed by the dentist, including maintaining logbooks.
Ensure that patient confidentiality is always maintained.
Adhere to all CQC, GDPR, and health and safety guidelines.
Attend off-site or online training as part of the dental nurse qualification.
Participate in the wider team effort, including reception duties or assisting other nurses and clinicians as needed.
Stay updated with current dental best practices and maintain CPD in line with GDC requirements (qualified nurses) or training program guidelines (trainees).
Essential Requirements:

A genuine interest in dental healthcare and patient welfare.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to enrol in and complete an accredited dental nursing qualification.
Professional appearance and attitude.
Ability to follow instructions and work under pressure.
Must be a resident on IOM or have a valid working permit
Desirable but not essential:

Previous experience in a healthcare or customer service role.
Knowledge of basic dental terminology.
Familiarity with dental software (e.g. SOE, R4) is a plus.

Notes
Karsons Pharmacy is looking for a reliable and enthusiastic Pharmacy Dispenser to join our friendly community pharmacy team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with at least 2 years' experience working in a community pharmacy who is passionate about delivering safe, accurate and efficient patient care. The role offers a varied workload, supporting the dispensary, assisting patients and customers, and occasionally undertaking pharmacy-related deliveries and collections.
Main Duties
Accurately prepare and dispense prescriptions under the supervision of the Pharmacist, provide excellent customer service, assist with prescription queries, maintain stock levels and inventory, receive and process deliveries, support the day-to-day operation of the dispensary, and carry out pharmacy deliveries or collections when required.
Essential Requirements
Minimum 2 years' experience working in a community pharmacy dispensary, a recognised dispensing qualification (or equivalent), experience using pharmacy dispensing systems, knowledge of NHS community pharmacy services, excellent attention to detail, strong customer service and communication skills, possess basic to intermediate computer literacy, the ability to work efficiently in a busy team environment, and a full, valid driving licence with the ability to drive as part of the role.
What We Offer
Competitive salary dependent on experience, a supportive and friendly working environment, ongoing training and professional development, the opportunity to work within a growing independent community pharmacy, and a varied role where you can make a real difference to patient care every day.
How to Apply
Please submit your CV together with a covering letter outlining your relevant pharmacy experience and telling us what professional value or principle guides the way you care for patients and work with others. Email your application to jobs@karsonspharmacy.co.uk.

Minimum 2 years' experience working in a community pharmacy dispensary, a recognised dispensing qualification (or equivalent), experience using pharmacy dispensing systems, knowledge of NHS community pharmacy services, excellent attention to detail, strong customer service and communication skills, possess basic to intermediate computer literacy, the ability to work efficiently in a busy team environment, and a full, valid driving licence with the ability to drive as part of the role.
What We Offer
Competitive salary dependent on experience, a supportive and friendly working environment, ongoing training and professional development, the opportunity to work within a growing independent community pharmacy, and a varied role where you can make a real difference to patient care every day.
How to Apply
Please submit your CV together with a covering letter outlining your relevant pharmacy experience and telling us what professional value or principle guides the way you care for patients and work with others. Email your application to jobs@karsonspharmacy.co.uk.

Notes
We are seeking a compassionate and proactive Health Care Assistant to join our dedicated team. In this vital role, you will provide essential support to the residents at Ellan Vannin Home, ensuring their comfort, safety, and well-being. Your enthusiasm and commitment will help create a warm, respectful environment where individuals feel valued and cared for. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful difference in people's lives while developing your skills in healthcare.

Responsibilities:

Assist residents with daily activities such as bathing, dressing, eating, and mobility to promote independence and dignity.
Support the implementation of personalised care plans tailored to each individual’s needs and preferences.
Monitor health conditions and report any changes or concerns to senior staff promptly.
Maintain accurate documentation of care provided, including updates to care plans and incident reports.
Communicate effectively with residents, clients, family members, and team members to ensure clear understanding and positive relationships.
Follow health and safety protocols diligently to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

Skills:

Experience working in a care home or home care environment is preferred but not essential; training will be provided for the right candidate.
Ability to understand and follow detailed care plans accurately.
Strong communication skills in English to interact effectively with residents, families, and team members.
Basic IT skills for maintaining electronic records and updating care documentation.
Compassionate attitude with excellent interpersonal skills to build trust and rapport with individuals receiving care.
Good organisational skills to manage multiple responsibilities efficiently.

Join us in delivering exceptional care that truly makes a difference! We are committed to supporting your growth through ongoing training and a positive team environment. This is a paid opportunity designed to empower you as you help others live healthier, happier lives.

To apply, please contact either Robert Moore (Registered Manager) at robert@ellanvanninhome.com or Bailey Sykes (Deputy Manager) at bailey@ellanvanninhome.com for an application form or for any queries.

The Isle of Man offers an excellent quality of life, beautiful coastline and countryside, short commutes and convenient connections to the UK and Ireland. Relocation support can be discussed.

There is excellent scope for general and advanced restorative dentistry, including Invisalign, composite bonding, oral surgery and implant dentistry, subject to training and competence.
Our practice is equipped with iTero and TRIOS 5 scanners, CBCT, digital radiography, in-house milling and 3D printing, a dental microscope, Guided Biofilm Therapy and conscious sedation facilities, allowing us to provide modern, efficient patient care.
We are looking for a kind, motivated and dependable dentist who is GDC registered or eligible for registration, has appropriate indemnity insurance and is committed to high standards of patient care and clinical governance.
Experience in Invisalign, restorative dentistry, implants, oral surgery or sedation would be advantageous but is not essential.
The Isle of Man offers an excellent quality of life, beautiful coastline and countryside, short commutes and convenient connections to the UK and Ireland. Relocation support can be discussed.

To apply, please send your CV and a short covering email to concierge@infinity.im.
All enquiries will be treated in confidence.

Notes
Are you a warm, caring person who finds real fulfilment in helping others live life to the fullest? 

Ambitions Recruitment is recruiting a Health Care Assistant on behalf of a locally owned and locally run care provider dedicated to supporting residents with genuine kindness, respect, and dignity. 

If you want a role where every day you can make a real difference to someone's life, this could be the perfect fit.As part of a close-knit team, you'll be there for residents in the moments that matter, supporting them with personal care in a way that protects their independence and honours their individual wishes. 

You'll get to know the people you care for, noticing the small changes in how they're feeling and speaking up if something doesn't seem right. You'll help keep everyone safe and well by following good hygiene practices, and you'll play an active part in shaping and reviewing care plans alongside nurses and other professionals. Above all, you'll treat every resident with the same respect, patience, and warmth you'd want for your own family.Day to day, this might mean helping someone move around safely and comfortably, encouraging them to eat and drink well, or simply sitting and chatting to brighten their day. Depending on your training, you may also help with medication. Sometimes you'll lend a hand with everyday domestic tasks too, like laundry, shopping, or preparing a meal, always making sure residents feel at home in a clean, safe environment.

We'd love to hear from you if you're a good communicator with a keen eye for detail and a genuine interest in people. No formal qualifications are needed to get started, though an RQF Level 2 in Health and Social Care is a bonus, or you can work towards it with our support (we'll help you complete your Care Certificate if you're just starting out). If you're keen to progress into medication administration down the line, a Level 3 RQF medication unit will be part of that journey. Most of all, we're looking for someone caring, cheerful, and hands-on, who's happy to get stuck in with personal care and everyday support. You'll be someone who can follow guidance closely while also trusting your own instincts, and who brings flexibility, reliability, and a friendly face to the team every day. 

As this role involves working closely with vulnerable people, we'll need an enhanced DBS check and two references, ideally including your most recent employer and any care experience you have.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you — get in touch with Ambitions Recruitment today.

If you are passionate about dentistry and eager to contribute to a thriving practice, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity as an Associate Dentist.

Smoky Sam’s BBQ is looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Restaurant Supervisor to join our team.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about great food, excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for both our customers and our team. As a Restaurant Supervisor, you’ll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the restaurant and helping to make sure every customer has a fantastic experience.

You’ll be responsible for supervising the team during shifts, ensuring the restaurant is running smoothly and maintaining our high standards of service, cleanliness and food quality. You’ll lead by example, support and motivate team members, and help create a friendly and welcoming environment.

The ideal person will have previous experience in a restaurant, hospitality or supervisory role, although we’re also happy to consider someone with the right attitude, personality and willingness to learn. You’ll need to be confident communicating with both customers and staff, able to stay calm and organised during busy periods, and comfortable taking responsibility when required.

You’ll help with opening and closing the restaurant, managing shifts, supporting the team during busy services, dealing with customer queries and resolving any issues professionally. You’ll also work closely with management to ensure company standards and procedures are followed.

We believe our team is just as important as the food we serve. We’re looking for someone who is reliable, approachable, hardworking and enjoys being part of a team. If you’re someone who takes pride in your work and wants to help us continue providing great food and great service, we’d love to hear from you.
 Please send a copy of your CV and a small bit about yourself and why you would be a great fit at Smoky Sam's to smokysamsbbq@gmail.com

Your main responsibilities will include keeping the kitchen, equipment and work areas clean and tidy, washing dishes and kitchen equipment, helping with deliveries and putting stock away, keeping the pot wash area organised and supporting the chefs with general kitchen tasks when required. You’ll also help maintain our high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and food safety throughout the kitchen.

We’re looking for someone who is hardworking, reliable and takes pride in keeping things clean and organised. Hospitality or kitchen experience is preferred but isn’t essential, as the right attitude and willingness to learn are just as important to us.

Smoky Sam’s can be a fast-paced environment, especially during busy services, so you’ll need to be able to work under pressure, keep a positive attitude and be willing to get stuck in wherever needed.

As a Kitchen Porter, you’ll be an important part of keeping the kitchen running smoothly. You’ll work closely with our chefs and kitchen team to make sure everything is clean, organised and ready for service.

Your main responsibilities will include keeping the kitchen, equipment and work areas clean and tidy, washing dishes and kitchen equipment, helping with deliveries and putting stock away, keeping the pot wash area organised and supporting the chefs with general kitchen tasks when required. You’ll also help maintain our high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and food safety throughout the kitchen.

We’re looking for someone who is hardworking, reliable and takes pride in keeping things clean and organised. Hospitality or kitchen experience is preferred but isn’t essential, as the right attitude and willingness to learn are just as important to us.

Smoky Sam’s can be a fast-paced environment, especially during busy services, so you’ll need to be able to work under pressure, keep a positive attitude and be willing to get stuck in wherever needed.

We’re proud of our team and believe that every role in the kitchen is important. If you’re looking for a role where you can learn, develop your skills and become part of a friendly and hardworking team, we’d love to hear from you.

Fancy running your own kitchen, shaping every menu, and genuinely improving residents' day-to-day quality of life? Our client is looking for a Head Chef to do exactly that, reporting straight to the CEO.

The job: plan menus that are tasty, nutritious, and on budget. Cook for a range of dietary needs, including modified-consistency meals that still look and taste great. Lead the kitchen team — hiring, appraisals, development, the lot. Keep stock levels sorted and standards of hygiene and infection control consistently high. Work alongside the Home Manager to keep raising the bar on the food offering, and be ready to step up for the occasional regulatory audit.

What you'll need: City & Guilds 7061/2 (or equivalent), a valid Food Hygiene Certificate, and two-plus years' commercial kitchen experience — ideally cooking for older people. Solid management chops (communication, budgeting, organisation) are a must, plus a good grip on health and safety rules.

Notes
Ambitions Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting a Sous Chef on behalf of a locally owned and locally run care provider . Reporting to the Head Chef, you will play a key role in supporting the kitchen team to create nutritious, flavoursome, and well-balanced menus for residents to a consistently high standard.

Day to day, you will prepare a varied range of meals and snacks, catering confidently for residents with specific dietary requirements. Working closely with healthcare staff, you will ensure meals are prepared to the correct consistency for those with swallowing difficulties, without compromising on taste or presentation. You will also make sure drinks and snacks are readily available between meals, take responsibility for stock ordering as needed, and help maintain a clean, tidy, hygienic, and safe kitchen environment at all times. High standards of infection prevention and control will be maintained throughout, and you will take part in regulatory audits and annual appraisals as required, along with any other duties commensurate with the role.

The ideal candidate will hold a City & Guilds 7061/2 qualification (or equivalent) in culinary skills, along with a current Food Hygiene Certificate and good literacy and numeracy skills. You will bring strong time management skills, the ability to stay calm under pressure, and a solid working knowledge of relevant health and safety legislation. Some experience catering for the dietary needs of older people would be desirable, and you will be a reliable, responsible team player, comfortable working within agreed budgets.

This is a full-time role working 44 hours per week, 7.30am to 7.30pm with a one-hour lunch break, with eligibility for overtime. Salary is commensurate with experience.

To apply or find out more, please email your CV to info@ambitions.co.im

Required to work day shifts: Wednesday, Thursday and Friday 9-4/5pm 21hrs + 1 Sunday a month We are closed on Sundays but once and occasionally twice a month you will be required to work a Sunday day-time for pop up events 

Day time Prep Cook responsibilities - To unload deliveries and prepare fresh plant based ingredients. You must be capable of following a prep list and recipes consistently to a high standard and unsupervised. At the end of the shift the kitchen needs to be cleaned down and washing up 
Experience of using various kitchen equipment including Combi ovens, dehydrators, Thermomix, blenders and induction hobs essential with an understanding of how fresh ingredients are prepared and cooked using different techniques.  Ability to multitask various prepping and cooking tasks in a set time scale. You will be working alone during the morning in the separate prep kitchen just off our roof garden. When lunch begins in the restaurant you will be working with the head chef helping to plate meals to order. After lunch you will be prepping again through the afternoon. Food safety & hygiene qualification required with an understanding of health and safety practices working in a kitchen. 

Ideal for someone with an interest in Plant based cooking or a newly qualified Hospitality -Catering College student wanting to work in a restaurant where you will be learning to handle fresh plant based ingredients and turn them into innovative sauces, marinades, pickles, chutneys, dressings, dips, fermentations, dehydrated garnishes, crackers, syrups, oils, sweet treats and more.

Apply to Head Chef Kyle Shimmin via email: hello@vibecafe.im

Notes
Taste Buds has been established for 40 years and provides delicious, high-quality home cooked fresh foods, coffee and outside catering services from our friendly, family run Douglas Sandwich Bar, Kitchen and Shop.
We are looking for an additional person to join our team who is bright, loves cooking and has a cheerful personality.

The job would be ideal for someone who is an experienced home cook who enjoys helping people and likes variety in their work. If this sounds like you, join us and become part of the family.   

This is a mixed role involving our kitchen and buffet food preparation, serving our lovely customers at lunchtimes and clearing after service.  Working hours to be mutually agreed will be around 07.30 am to 2.45 pm (Mon – Fri). This is a Monday – Friday permanent role (i.e. non-seasonal & no split shifts).

An excellent standard and understanding of verbal and written English is required to enable instructions from customers to be completed accurately. We would welcome applications from experienced individuals, however we can also train you in any areas required. 

Our business is geared to the corporate market and therefore our food must always go out on time, which means we need 100% reliability with your time keeping and attendance. You’ll be smart and clean in your appearance. Please do not apply if your time keeping or attendance will not be 100% reliable due to personal or health reasons. We are a non-smoking food company and therefore you are not allowed to smoke during working hours.
   
To apply, please e-mail your CV to callum@tastebuds.im, or pop into the shop – Taste Buds, 5 – 6 Railway Shops, Peel Road, Douglas to collect a job application form.

Notes
CAFE ASSISTANT
Cosy NOA | Cosy Nook, Port Erin -Saturday role

We’re looking for a Cafe Assistant to join our tiny but mighty team at Cosy NOA. Perched right by the beach at Cosy Nook in Port Erin, we might be small, but we’re a proper little community hub.

We have amazing regulars, sandy feet coming through the door, great coffee, NOA bakes and one of the best views on the Island.

Now we need another brilliant human to join us on Saturdays.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
A bit of everything, basically, you’ll be: taking orders, making and serving drinks, helping get food out, warming things up and keeping an eye on those almond croissants that definitely need a few more minutes in the oven.

You’ll chat to our regulars, welcome people who’ve never visited before and help make Cosy feel like Cosy.

It can get busy, so you’ll need to be a natural multitasker who can keep smiling when there are coffees to make, food to serve, tables to clear and three people asking you something at once.

You’ll also help keep our little snug clean, tidy and ready for whoever walks through the door next.

WHO WE’RE AFTER
Experience is great, but attitude matters more. Our team can teach you everything you need to know. We’re looking for someone who:

is naturally friendly and loves chatting to people.
can juggle a few things at once without losing their head.
is reliable and understands how important that is in a tiny team.
is happy to jump between taking orders, serving food, cleaning and whatever else needs doing.
cares about great food and coffee.
takes pride in keeping our space looking lovely.
genuinely cares about giving people a great experience.
gets what NOA is about and wants to be part of it.

THE TEAM
We’re a super small team, which means everyone matters.

The Cosy crew are reliable, supportive and brilliant at looking out for each other. You won’t be expected to walk in knowing everything. We’ll train you, show you the ropes and help you get confident with all the different parts of the job.

What we do need from you is energy, reliability and a willingness to get stuck in.

WHY COSY?
Because it’s a pretty special little place.

Cosy Nook is part café, part beachside hideaway and part community living room.

Our customers aren’t just transactions. They’re swimmers warming up after the sea, families grabbing a treat, dog walkers, beachgoers and regulars whose orders we already know.

We want someone who will care about our products, our place and our people as much as we do.

If spending your Saturdays serving great food and coffee by the beach with a lovely little crew sounds like your kind of thing, come join Cosy.

If you want to apply, please send your up to date CV to pippa@noabakehouse.com.

Notes
If you're the kind of person who steps up without being asked, takes pride in running a great shift and genuinely enjoys helping others succeed, this role is for you. 

Reports To: Store Manager / Assistant Store Manager. 
Direct Reports: Baristas and store partners during assigned shifts. 
Location: Store Based - both Peel Road Drive Thru and Victoria Street cafe. 
Contract: Full time and part time available. 
Pay: £14.71 per hour. 

The Role 
As a Shift Supervisor at Crema, you're the leader on shift. You'll run the floor, support your team, hold standards and make sure every customer leaves with a brilliant experience, even when it's busy, short-staffed or challenging. 

This is a step up from Barista and the start of a real leadership journey. Most of our Assistant Managers and Store Managers have come through this role. If you want to grow with us, this is where it starts. 

What You'll Be Doing 
Leading the store during your shift, deploying the team, maintaining pace and making sure standards are met from open to close. 
Coaching and supporting Baristas in the moment, not just when there's a problem. 
Delivering an exceptional customer experience and dealing with complaints confidently and professionally. 
Holding health and safety, food safety and operational standards every shift, without exception. 
Making confident decisions when things don't go to plan, without always needing to escalate. 
Recognising good work and creating a positive, focused environment on shift. 
Communicating clearly with the rest of the management team about what's happening in store. 
Supporting new team members through their training and onboarding. 

What We're Looking For 
Previous experience in a customer-facing role, ideally in hospitality or food service.
A natural leader, someone people look to, even without the title. 
Calm under pressure with the ability to prioritise and make decisions quickly. 
High standards and the consistency to hold them even when it's hard. 
A genuine interest in developing others. 
Clear, confident communication with both customers and colleagues. 

What You'll Get 
Free hand crafted beverages on shift.  
30% discount on food and bottled beverages while on shift.  
30% discount on all items while off shift, across all participating stores (not exclusive to Crema). 
5 weeks holiday entitlement. 
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Program, access to free sanitary products while at work, team building summer and winter event. 
Real progression opportunities, we promote from within wherever we can. 
A team that looks out for each other. 

Our Values 
Everything we do at Crema is guided by four values - 

Courage - step forward, especially when it's hard.
Integrity - do the right thing, even when no one is watching.
Empowerment - take ownership and help others grow.
Purpose - connect what you do to something bigger.

For more details and to apply contact darren.kerruish@cafefortune.uk

You’ll be expected to take responsibility for your section, including preparation, stock rotation, ordering and maintaining a clean and organised workstation. You’ll also help support junior members of the kitchen team, communicate effectively during service and work closely with the senior kitchen team to keep services running smoothly.

We’re looking for someone who is reliable, organised and passionate about hospitality. You’ll need to be a strong team player with a positive attitude and the ability to stay calm and focused during busy services.

If you’re looking for your next challenge and want to be part of a growing BBQ restaurant with a strong team and plenty of opportunity to develop, we’d love to hear from you.
