Notes
We are seeking an energetic and passionate Head Chef to join our team, who is keen to
take an active role in both the executive management of the business, as well as being
hands-on in the kitchen. We are looking for an individual who can take a holistic view on the
business, and work with our General Manager and Owners to further refine and define the
next stages of the business strategy and implementation of the same to carry Kellas into the
future, building on the strong foundations already laid.

On a day-to-day basis, our Head Chef will be hands-on, leading our culinary team and
elevating the dining experience. In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of food
preparation, kitchen operations, and team management to ensure the highest standards of
quality, safety, and hospitality. Your leadership will inspire creativity in the kitchen while
maintaining efficient workflows and exceptional service. This is an exciting opportunity for a
culinary professional eager to make a lasting impact through exceptional cuisine and
outstanding team collaboration.

Summary of Key Responsibilities
Work closely with the rest of the Executive Management Team to drive food sales
and enhance the guest experience.
Design and develop menus, seasonal dishes, and daily specials.
Recruit, train, motivate, and develop kitchen team members.
Prepare and deliver high-quality fresh food to consistently high standards. With a
strong ability in breads and sauces and creative knack for adapting British classics
and giving them a modern twist.
Lead and manage the day-to-day running of the kitchen.
Lead kitchen service and ensure smooth operation during busy periods.
Monitor gross profit margins and food costs to ensure profitability targets are met.
Manage food ordering, stock control, and supplier relationships.
Control stock levels, minimise waste, and maximise kitchen efficiency.
Maintain exceptional standards of food hygiene, cleanliness, and kitchen
organisation.
Ensure full compliance with food safety, health and safety, and allergen regulations.
Manage kitchen paperwork, due diligence records, and HACCP procedures.

To apply for the position, please submit your CV and cover letter via email to our General Manager, at neil@kellas.im

future, building on the strong foundations already laid.

elevating the dining experience. In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of food
preparation, kitchen operations, and team management to ensure the highest standards of
quality, safety, and hospitality. Your leadership will inspire creativity in the kitchen while
maintaining efficient workflows and exceptional service. This is an exciting opportunity for a
culinary professional eager to make a lasting impact through exceptional cuisine and
outstanding team collaboration.

Work closely with the rest of the Executive Management Team to drive food sales
and enhance the guest experience.
Design and develop menus, seasonal dishes, and daily specials.
Recruit, train, motivate, and develop kitchen team members.
Prepare and deliver high-quality fresh food to consistently high standards. With a
strong ability in breads and sauces and creative knack for adapting British classics
and giving them a modern twist.
Lead and manage the day-to-day running of the kitchen.
Lead kitchen service and ensure smooth operation during busy periods.

Using data, insights, and advanced business analysis techniques, you will understand journey performance, find opportunities to improve, and turn your findings into meaningful results. Working within our Commercial Banking division, you'll help shape and optimise customer journeys that support the evolving needs of business and corporate customers.
Ensure customer needs remain central to decision-making by using both qualitative and quantitative insights to inform journey development, prioritisation, and product development. Collaborating with Product, Experience Design, Engineering, and operational teams, help build seamless end-to-end experiences that work flawlessly across functional boundaries.
Additionally, you'll support continuous improvement by defining problems, evaluating options, and crafting recommendations that improve customer outcomes, colleague experiences, and business performance. Your work will ensure that processes, systems, and technology solutions deliver the intended experiences.

Why join us? 
We’re transforming at pace. Investing billions in our people, data and tech to change the way we meet the needs of our 28 million customers. We’re growing, and we’d love you to be part of the journey.  

What we’re looking for?
Data Analysis & Customer Insight – Minimum of 2 years analysing and interpreting data from various sources. These include transactional, behavioural, demographic, and operational data to produce valuable insights. This supports business decisions centred on the customer.
Analytical Problem Solving – Experience using structured approaches such as process mapping, root cause analysis, and problem solving based on hypotheses to find opportunities and develop practical solutions.
Elicitation & Business Analysis – Experience gathering, documenting and refining business requirements through engagement with stakeholders, translating customer, colleague and business needs into clear recommendations and actionable outcomes.
Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication – Ability to build trusted relationships, influence collaborators, and drive alignment across teams through effective communication and engagement.
Customer-Centred Thinking – Experience using customer and colleague insight to support improvements in products, processes, or services. A growth mindset, curiosity, and enthusiasm for improving customer outcomes are key.

Notes
Hansard Global Plc is a listed company on the London Stock Exchange since 2006. The focus of the Hansard group is the international sale of life assurance products with a primary focus being on unit-linked products to ex-patriate customers based in various countries around the world. There is a truly global feel to Hansard, with a workforce based across the Isle of Man, Ireland, Malaysia, and Japan working together to achieve our goals.

The Risk & Governance Analyst is responsible for supporting the effective operation of the Technology & Change risk and governance framework. The role ensures that risk, control, policy, audit, outsourcing and regulatory activities are coordinated, monitored and reported in a timely and consistent manner.

Working closely with Technology leadership, risk owners and key stakeholders, the role helps maintain a strong control environment through the management of risk assessments, risk registers, policy reviews, supplier governance and audit activities, while supporting compliance with internal standards and regulatory requirements.

Support the effective operation of the Enterprise Risk Management Framework within Technology. 
Maintain the Technology Risk Register ensuring risks, controls and actions are accurately documented and regularly reviewed. 
Facilitate regular risk and control reviews with Technology Management and risk owners, ensuring the effectiveness of controls.
Support and conduct risk assessments, including assessments for Technology, change initiatives, new services, outsourcing arrangements and material suppliers.
Facilitate and support Technology internal and external Audits. 

Requirements:
Experience working within a risk, controls, Audit and/or governance role.
Strong understanding of risk management and control frameworks, including risk assessments, root cause analysis (RCA), corrective and preventative actions, remediation planning, control monitoring and continuous improvement activities.
Effective communicator with strong organisational and coordination skills, able to manage competing priorities and maintain attention to detail.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate risks, identify root causes, assess impacts and support effective practical solutions.
Ability to produce prompt, accurate, clear and concise reporting 
Demonstrates initiative, accountability and a sense of ownership for delivering outcomes.

To Apply- Please email your CV to careers@hansard.com

https://apogeecorp.ciphr-irecruit.com/applicants/vacancy/818/1st-Line-Support-Technician

JOB DETAILS

As a 1st Line Helpdesk Technician, you will be the first point of contact for customers needing support with IT, hardware, software and network-related issues.

You will handle incoming support requests, diagnose problems, provide remote support where possible, and escalate more complex issues to the right team when needed. This is a customer-focused role, so keeping clients updated and delivering a helpful, professional service is key.

The role will involve:

Responding to customer support requests by phone, email or ticketing system.
Logging, managing and updating support tickets accurately.
Providing first-line troubleshooting for laptops, desktops, applications, servers and network issues.
Using remote access tools to investigate and resolve IT faults.
Keeping customers informed on progress and agreed next steps.
Escalating issues where they cannot be resolved at first point of contact.
Supporting service levels by responding to issues promptly and professionally.
A typical working pattern is Monday to Friday, 08:30 to 17:30, with a one-hour lunch break. This role also offers flexibility to work from home, typically two days per week for a five-day working week once training is complete.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Experience supporting customers with IT, hardware or software issues.
Good understanding of laptops, desktops, basic networking and common IT applications.
Confident troubleshooting skills across Windows PCs, Macs, printers or connected devices.
Knowledge of basic network terms such as IP addressing, DNS and routing.
Experience using remote support or ticketing tools would be useful.
Ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users.
A practical approach to problem solving and knowing when to escalate issues.
We value candidates with AI literacy – individuals who are curious about technology, comfortable exploring automation, and eager to contribute to a modern, forward-thinking business.

Location: Douglas, Isle of Man.

Job Summary
plan.com is one of the fastest growing tech companies in the UK and the Isle of Man, and our finance function is evolving just as quickly. We are seeking a driven, dynamic and meticulous Financial Reporting Accountant to join our team at a genuinely interesting point in that journey: we are investing in automation and AI to take the manual effort out of reporting, so that the team can spend more of its time on analysis, insight and control.
The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring accuracy and compliance across our financial reporting processes for our UK and Isle of Man entities, with a drive to understand the complexities of our business and the ability to tackle problems from all sorts of different angles. Just as importantly, they will be expected to question how things are done today and help us do them better tomorrow — whether that means refining a process in Dynamics 365 Business Central, rebuilding a report, or using AI tools to remove a manual workaround.
This role involves various aspects of corporate finance and collaborating with stakeholders across the business to ensure regulatory compliance and transparency. The Financial Reporting Accountant will play a crucial role in maintaining the integrity of financial records and supporting decision-making processes within the organisation, and offers the chance for the successful candidate to evolve alongside our company as we embark on our next phase of expansion.

Full details of the role, including duties and responsibilities, and how to apply can be found on our website - www.plan.com/careers

Target-driven and data-literate, the Account Manager will use insight and CRM data to identify growth levers, tackle underperformance, and build development plans that turn opportunity into consistent, quality trading relationships. They'll recognise that internal colleagues are customers too, and that both relationships require the same commercial rigour and care.

Role Overview:

The successful candidate will have a hunter mentality and a genuine hunger for building, growing, and developing partner relationships that drive revenue. Working closely with our Business Development Managers and Partner Support team, the Account Manager will own a portfolio of partner accounts — proactively engaging with new and existing partners to assess performance, unlock growth opportunities, and ensure business targets are met.

Target-driven and data-literate, the Account Manager will use insight and CRM data to identify growth levers, tackle underperformance, and build development plans that turn opportunity into consistent, quality trading relationships. They'll recognise that internal colleagues are customers too, and that both relationships require the same commercial rigour and care.

Energetic, resilient, and adaptable, the Account Manager will thrive in a fast-paced environment — collaborative within a small, competitive team, but self-motivated enough to drive their own portfolio forward.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:

Research, qualify, and proactively engage with new partners to assess and unlock revenue streams.
Proactively engage with existing partners to assess performance, identify growth levers, and drive alignment with plan.com.
Collaborate with New Business Executives by booking meetings, preparing materials, and managing follow-ups.
Manage a portfolio of target accounts and create outbound sales campaigns.
Work closely with marketing to act on campaign leads and nurture them into qualified opportunities.
Build and execute partner development plans for target accounts.
Maintain accurate and timely CRM records of outreach, opportunity status, and partner engagement.
Gather and document partner intelligence, feeding insights back into the business.
Gather and document competitor intelligence, feeding insights back into the business.
Identify blockers to business growth and propose solutions to resolve them.
Drive my.plan adoption and strengthen its market position.
Utilise data and insight to identify and drive growth opportunities.

Notes
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Project Manager to oversee the successful delivery of projects from mobilisation through to completion. You will be responsible for coordinating project activities, managing programmes, monitoring costs and procurement, and ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time and to the required quality standards.

The role will involve preparing cost estimates, managing subcontractors and suppliers, attending site visits and inspections, monitoring progress and identifying and resolving risks and issues. You will provide regular updates to senior management on project costs, programme, risks and opportunities, while maintaining accurate project records and ensuring compliance with health & safety, quality and regulatory requirements.

You will work closely with clients, contractors, suppliers and internal teams, building strong professional relationships and ensuring projects are delivered effectively and to the highest standard.

About You

Notes
We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Promotions Strategy & Optimisation Manager to drive the performance of promotions, campaigns and bonuses across our Sportsbook and Casino products.
Key Responsibilities
Promotions & Performance Optimisation:
Lead the optimisation of promotions, campaigns and bonus activity across Sportsbook and Casino.  Analyse performance to understand which offers and mechanics are delivering against their objectives.  Identify inefficient or underperforming activity and recommend improvements to targeting, mechanics, rewards and timing.
Identify opportunities to scale or further improve successful promotions.   Define and monitor KPIs including promotional cost, participation, conversion, retention, engagement and player value.  Assess the incremental impact of promotional activity to understand the true value generated.  Establish a strong test-and-learn approach using A/B testing, control groups and experimentation.
Personalisation & Automation:
Work with CRM, BI, Product and other teams to improve promotional targeting and personalisation.  Identify opportunities to use player behaviour, preferences and value to determine the most relevant offer, reward and timing.  Support the development of automated promotional decision-making and personalised journeys.
Explore how predictive models and machine learning can improve promotional effectiveness.  Define success measures and continuously evaluate automated activity.
Innovation & Collaboration:
Keep up to date with developments in Sportsbook and Casino promotions, bonusing and player engagement.  Monitor competitor activity and identify new mechanics, capabilities and opportunities.  Bring new ideas to the Promotions team and challenge existing approaches where data suggests there is a better way.
Work closely with Promotions, CRM, BI and Product to turn insights into practical improvements.  The above duties provide a generic description of the Employee’s day to day responsibilities but should in no way be deemed to be an exhaustive list. Additional related, duties may be assigned by the Line Manager in line with business exigencies and continuity.
What We're Looking For:
Experience in promotions, bonusing, CRM, commercial analytics, player analytics or a related optimisation role.  Experience within Sportsbook, Casino, iGaming or a similar digital industry.  A highly analytical and data-driven mindset with strong commercial judgement.  Experience evaluating campaign or promotional performance against clear objectives.  A strong understanding of segmentation, targeting and personalisation.  Experience with experimentation and test-and-learn methodologies.
An understanding of how automation and machine learning can support marketing and promotional decision-making.  The ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.  Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

For more details and to apply contact talent@silverspin.com or 07624269891.

Science Club Leader

We are looking for an enthusiastic, creative and responsible person to join the Fun Science team as a Science Club Leader.

The successful candidate will lead fun, hands-on science activities and experiments during our after-school and holiday clubs. All activities, equipment and training will be provided, so you do not need to be a science expert - just enthusiastic about working with children and excited to get stuck in!

The role involves:

Leading science activities and experiments with groups of young children.
Explaining activities clearly and ensuring children follow safety instructions.
Managing a group of children and responding confidently to different situations.
Setting up and clearing away equipment and keeping the activity area tidy.
Ensuring children are supervised and leave safely with their responsible adult.

The position would ideally suit someone with previous experience of working with children or young people. We are particularly looking for someone who demonstrates initiative, good judgement, confidence and enthusiasm, and who can take charge when needed.

As part of the interview process, candidates will be asked to give examples of situations where they have:

Taken initiative to complete a task without being asked.
Used their judgement to deal with a challenging or delicate situation.
Demonstrated responsibility when working with children or young people.

Clubs are held at various times and locations across the Isle of Man. After-school clubs generally take place during weekday afternoons, after the school day has finished, while holiday clubs take place during school holidays. A full driving licence and access to your own vehicle is preferred, as travel between different venues may be required.

An enhanced DBS check will be completed for the successful candidate.

Due to the nature of the role, which involves responsibility for children and working with substances that may be hazardous if handled incorrectly, candidates must be over 18 years of age, in accordance with the Employment of Children Regulations 2018.

To apply, please send your CV and a brief covering statement, along with details of two recent referees, to isleofman@fun-science.org.uk.

DELIVERY DRIVER & PACKAGING ASSISTANT
NOA Bakehouse | Isle of Man 5am to 1pm | 30 to 40 hours per week | Includes Saturday
We’re looking for a Delivery Driver & Packaging Assistant to join the early doors crew at NOA.

While most of the Island is still waking up, you’ll be helping package bread and bakery goods fresh from the ovens, picking the morning orders and getting them out to our wholesale customers and retailers across the Island. Then comes the pretty dreamy bit.
Radio on. Van loaded. Fresh bread in the back. Some of the best driving routes on the Island ahead of you.
Not a bad way to spend a morning.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
You’ll start the day at the bakery, working with the team to package freshly baked products and pick the morning’s orders.
Every day is slightly different. Orders change, customers need different things and sometimes the delivery route needs a rethink before you head out.
It’s a proper team effort to get everything out of the door on time, so you’ll need to be switched on, upbeat and happy to muck in.
Once the van is loaded, you’ll deliver to our wholesale customers and retailers across the Island, making sure the right things get to the right people and representing NOA brilliantly while you’re out and about.
And when the bakery needs an extra pair of hands, everyone gets involved.
That might mean helping clean down the bakery, refreshing the leaven, packing a few more loaves or just jumping onto whatever needs doing to get the team over the line.
No egos. Just good people getting it done together.

WHO WE’RE AFTER
We’re looking for someone who: is upbeat, friendly and a genuinely great team player, is reliable and ready to go at 5am, enjoys driving and is confident out on the Island’s roads, is organised and can adapt when orders or routes change and takes pride in getting the details right . Someone who is happy to get stuck in wherever the team needs help, cares about great food, local businesses and what NOA is all about, understands that delivering our products means representing NOA out in the community and has a full valid driving licence.

THE HOURS
5am to 1pm, including Saturday. Around 30 to 40 hours per week depending on the rota.  Yes, it’s an early alarm.
But you’ll also get quiet roads, some pretty epic Manx sunrises, the radio for company and a van that smells like freshly baked bread.
And by early afternoon, your working day is done.
WHY NOA?
We’re about good bread, good ingredients and good people.
We care about real food, doing things properly, supporting local and building a business that has a positive impact on the Island we call home.
This role is a big part of that.

If you want to apply please sedn you CV to pippa@noabakehouse.com

JUNIOR BAKER NOA Bakehouse | Isle of Man - 5am to 1pm | 5 days a week | Includes Saturday

We’re looking for a Junior Baker to join the crew at NOA. This is a hands on bakery role for someone who loves real food, doesn’t mind an early start and wants to properly learn the craft of making great bread.

You’ll be working across the bakery, getting stuck into the mixing room, helping shape our breads, packaging the good stuff and picking orders ready to head out to our wholesale customers across the Island.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
You’ll learn to run the mixing room and mixer, working with our doughs and understanding what makes them tick.

You’ll help divide and shape bread, support the bakers through production, and make sure everything is packed, picked and ready for our wholesale customers.

It’s physical, fast paced work. There’s flour involved. Quite a lot of it.

WHO WE’RE AFTER
You don’t need to arrive knowing everything about baking. Attitude matters more.

We’re looking for someone who is eager to learn and takes pride in doing things properly, is a brilliant team player and is reliable, especially when the alarm goes off early.

You’ll care about real food made from real ingredients, share our belief in food without unnecessary ultra processed nonsense, and think local matters and care about where food comes from.

You’ll be ethically minded and want to work somewhere that gives a damn, and you’ll enjoy working with your hands and being part of a busy production team.

THE HOURS
5am to 1pm, five days a week, including Saturday.

Yep, 5am is early.

But there’s something pretty good about making bread while most of the Island is still asleep, and finishing your working day at 1pm isn’t bad either.

WHY NOA? We’re about good bread, good ingredients and good people.

We care about making food properly, supporting local wherever we can and building a food business that has a positive impact on the place we call home.

No unnecessary UPFs. No shortcuts for the sake of it. Just proper food made by people who care.

If that sounds like your kind of thing, come bake with us.

If you want to apply, please send your up to date CV to pippa@noabakehouse.com.

Notes
Job Role – Ground Security Officer
Our Aviation Security Team at the Isle of Man Airport gets the training they need to excel at what they do. We don't believe in one-size-fits-all approaches and you will get hands on coaching and mentoring. We assess what our team actually faces day-to-day and make sure everyone has the right skills for the job. It's about looking after each other and making sure you feel confident and prepared in your role.
What Nobody Tells You – The Good
You’ll develop instincts that serve you everywhere in life.
The moment you pass certification is a genuine high.
Progressing from observation to solo operation builds real confidence.
The satisfaction of smooth operations is surprisingly addictive.
Your teammates become a second family (shift work bonds are real).
Skills you gain here are transferable globally.
The passengers you protect will rarely thank you. They won’t know the threats you’ve prevented or the situations you’ve defused. But every flight that lands safely, every reunion at arrivals, every business deal completed – you made that possible.
What We Need
The role of an Aviation Security Officer requires you to be self-motivated and disciplined, with a need to be physically fit as there is a small amount of lifting required.
Hours of work are split into shifts, an Early Shift and a Late Shift. Your Team will be working two lates followed by two early shifts, and then two days off.
You will be required to be vetted, with a full 5-year background check, and apply through our sponsorship for a Criminal Records Check.
What We Provide
We provide full two week classroom training to give you the theory for the role, followed by a period of On-the-Job training that develops your practical skill set.
You will be provided with a full uniform to look smart and professional
Holiday entitlement is 28 days per annum.
Please apply using the below link; 
https://careers.bidvestnoonan.com/vacancies/26107/security-officer.html

We are delighted to be working with an established specialist investment management firm who are seeking an experienced Compliance Officer / MLRO to join their team on a part-time basis, approximately 2.5 days per week. This is an excellent opportunity for a compliance professional with investment management experience to take responsibility for a key regulatory function within an established business. The successful candidate will be responsible for the Isle of Man compliance function, ensuring the business continues to meet its regulatory obligations. The firm is regulated by the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority (IOMFSA) as an Investment Manager and also operates within a US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) regulated environment. The role will focus primarily on Isle of Man regulatory requirements, with external specialist support already in place for US SEC compliance matters. Previous SEC experience would be beneficial but is not essential. Key Responsibilities: Act as Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) for Isle of Man regulated activities. Maintain and oversee the compliance framework in line with IOMFSA requirements. Provide compliance advice and guidance to the business. Review, update and maintain compliance policies, procedures and controls. Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of relevant changes. Oversee AML/CFT obligations and ensure appropriate controls remain in place. Support regulatory reporting and compliance monitoring activities. Work alongside external advisers supporting US SEC compliance requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Previous experience within investment management compliance. Experience working within a regulated financial services environment. Experience acting as a Compliance Officer and/or MLRO. Strong understanding of AML/CFT requirements and regulatory frameworks. The ability to work independently and manage a broad compliance remit. Strong communication skills with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders. Experience within asset management, hedge funds or investment firms would be highly desirable.

Notes
About the Role

Prospero Facilities Services Limited is seeking a Service Coordinator to join our busy Helpdesk Team. The Helpdesk is central to our operations, providing an important link between our clients and Engineering Teams and ensuring that maintenance requirements are coordinated and progressed efficiently.

The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering a high standard of customer service while supporting our Engineering Teams in the delivery of both reactive and planned maintenance services. The role requires someone who is organised, proactive and able to manage a variety of tasks in a busy working environment.

Key Responsibilities

The Service Coordinator will be responsible for managing incoming telephone calls and emails and liaising effectively with clients, engineers and other members of the team. The role will involve coordinating planned and reactive maintenance jobs, ensuring work is scheduled efficiently and progressed within the required timescales.

The successful candidate will be responsible for creating, updating, tracking and closing work orders using internal and external Computer-Aided Facilities Management (CAFM) systems. They will also prepare, analyse and distribute job reports and associated paperwork, ensuring information is accurate and kept up to date.

The role will also provide general operational and administrative support to the business, including progressing quotations, orders and other tasks as required. The Service Coordinator will be expected to maintain an awareness of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and appropriate risk management and compliance requirements.

Essential Skills and Experience

Applicants should have strong IT skills and be confident using Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook, together with database management systems. Excellent attention to detail and strong data-handling skills are essential, as is the ability to communicate effectively by telephone, email and face-to-face.

The successful candidate should have a proactive approach to learning new systems and processes and be able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Desirable Skills and Experience

Previous experience within facilities management, engineering, maintenance or a related industry would be advantageous. Previous Health and Safety training or awareness would also be desirable, although training will be provided where appropriate.

What We Offer

Prospero offers a competitive salary and a supportive and professional working environment. The successful candidate will have access to a voluntary pension scheme and private healthcare, together with opportunities for continued training, learning and long-term professional development within the Prospero Group.

Interested?  Send your CV to hr@prospero.im or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

About the Role

Prospero Facilities Services Limited is seeking a Service Coordinator to join our busy Helpdesk Team. The Helpdesk is central to our operations, providing an important link between our clients and Engineering Teams and ensuring that maintenance requirements are coordinated and progressed efficiently.

The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering a high standard of customer service while supporting our Engineering Teams in the delivery of both reactive and planned maintenance services. The role requires someone who is organised, proactive and able to manage a variety of tasks in a busy working environment.

Key Responsibilities

The Service Coordinator will be responsible for managing incoming telephone calls and emails and liaising effectively with clients, engineers and other members of the team. The role will involve coordinating planned and reactive maintenance jobs, ensuring work is scheduled efficiently and progressed within the required timescales.

The successful candidate will be responsible for creating, updating, tracking and closing work orders using internal and external Computer-Aided Facilities Management (CAFM) systems. They will also prepare, analyse and distribute job reports and associated paperwork, ensuring information is accurate and kept up to date.

The role will also provide general operational and administrative support to the business, including progressing quotations, orders and other tasks as required. The Service Coordinator will be expected to maintain an awareness of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and appropriate risk management and compliance requirements.

Essential Skills and Experience

Applicants should have strong IT skills and be confident using Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook, together with database management systems. Excellent attention to detail and strong data-handling skills are essential, as is the ability to communicate effectively by telephone, email and face-to-face.

The successful candidate should have a proactive approach to learning new systems and processes and be able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Desirable Skills and Experience

Previous experience within facilities management, engineering, maintenance or a related industry would be advantageous. Previous Health and Safety training or awareness would also be desirable, although training will be provided where appropriate.

What We Offer

Prospero offers a competitive salary and a supportive and professional working environment. The successful candidate will have access to a voluntary pension scheme and private healthcare, together with opportunities for continued training, learning and long-term professional development within the Prospero Group.

Interested?  Send your CV to hr@prospero.im or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

Notes
Our client seeks a TCSP Compliance Officer to join their team on a part-time basis. Subject to regulatory approval, and after adequate training and familiarisation, the role holder will ultimately hold the following statutory positions: Compliance Officer, under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book. Ideally, Money Laundering Reporting Officer, under the IOM AML/CFT Code 2019. You must be able to satisfy the IOM FSA on competence, time commitment, accessibility and effective oversight. An initial familiarisation period may be agreed before specific statutory positions are formally transferred. Key Responsibilities: Discharge the statutory Compliance Officer role under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book, acting as primary point of contact with the IOM FSA. Maintain compliance monitoring programme, regulatory returns, statutory registers, policy suite and the authorisation of new SPV structures. Oversee periodic client reviews and approve higher-risk new business across the SPV book. Ideally hold the MLRO function, receive internal reports, liaise with the IOM Financial Intelligence Unit. Run group sanctions screening (OFSI, OFAC, EU, UN), customer due diligence and transaction monitoring proportionate to the group's exposure, with particular attention to maritime risk. Deliver annual AML/CFT training to employees and report to the relevant boards on financial crime risk. Maintain the compliance requirements and risk assessment suite, AML/CFT and policy suite, and report to the Board. Key Skills and Experience: Ideally minimum three years' compliance experience in regulated financial services. Working knowledge of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book and AML/CFT Code 2019. Recognised compliance qualification such as the ICA Diploma in Compliance, the CISI Diploma in Investment Compliance or equivalent. Based in the Isle of Man. Track record of direct FSA engagement. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16832

Notes
Hansard Global Plc is a listed company on the London Stock Exchange since 2006. The focus of the Hansard group is the international sale of life assurance products with a primary focus being on unit-linked products to ex-patriate customers based in various countries around the world. There is a truly global feel to Hansard, with a workforce based across the Isle of Man, Ireland, Malaysia, Dubai working together to achieve our goals.

This role supports the Company Secretarial Team with the effective administration of Hansard’s governance framework, while providing structured exposure to the responsibilities of a chartered secretary/governance professional in a listed group environment. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Support board, committee and governance meetings as part of a structured trainee development role, including scheduling, agenda preparation, board pack collation and circulation.
Assist with the maintenance of company secretarial records, statutory registers, governance trackers and corporate records, developing an understanding of good governance practice and statutory record keeping requirements.
Support the preparation, review and organisation of meeting materials, governance updates, action logs and supporting papers, learning how information is presented to boards and committees.
Track actions and information requests arising from board, committee and governance meetings, helping to ensure timely follow-up and clear accountability.
Assist with statutory and regulatory filings, notifications and returns, gaining practical experience of corporate compliance obligations and governance deadlines.
Support entity administration activities, including maintaining company information, director and officer records, group structure information and other corporate governance data.
Develop and maintain governance reporting mechanisms, including Excel spreadsheets, action trackers, entity records and board reporting tools, with guidance from senior members of the team.
Build knowledge of company secretarial procedures, governance standards and listed company administration through supervised practical work and professional development.

Requirements
Educated to A-Level standard (or equivalent) and a willingness to learn and develop professionally (Essential)
Previous experience in corporate administration or a similar administrative role, with an interest in
developing as a governance professional. (Desirable)
Currently studying towards, or willing to study towards, a CGI/Chartered Governance qualification,
with study support available subject to the applicable study support policy (Desirable)
Highly self-motivated, with a willingness to participate in and actively support process improvements(Desirable)
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with a wide range of audiences(Essential)

To apply, please email your CV to careers@hansard.com

From activities and family support to advocacy and shaping better services, their work has a real and lasting impact across the Island.

Joining Mencap means becoming part of a small, committed team with a big sense of purpose, where your ideas, energy and contribution really matter.

Create opportunities. Build connections. Make a difference.  This is a rewarding, people-focused role creating and coordinating activities and experiences for adults with learning disabilities across the Island.

You’ll work closely with individuals, families, carers and community partners to develop accessible and engaging activities, bring events to life and create opportunities for people to connect, try something new and participate more fully in their community.

We’re looking for someone who brings:
Experience working with people with learning disabilities or within community engagement.  
Great communication skills and a natural ability to build relationships.  
Strong organisation, initiative and the confidence to work independently.  
 The ability to coordinate activities and keep multiple moving parts on track.  
Confidence using Microsoft Office and online communication platforms.  
A genuine commitment to inclusion, choice and independence.
  
Experience in events or project coordination, social media and content creation, safeguarding or measuring outcomes would be an advantage.  Some evening and weekend flexibility will be required and the successful applicant will be subject to an Enhanced DBS check.

If you’re someone who brings people together, turns ideas into opportunities and wants to see the difference your work makes, this could be the role for you.

Find out more here - https://www.paragon.co.im/careers/32634/index1/Adult-Activity-Coordinator-Permanent-Job-Isle-Man-Permanent-Isle-Man-Pp22841

Notes
We are looking for an experienced life insurance underwriter to join our Underwriting team. You will assess complex risks, make informed underwriting decisions and contribute to the development of underwriting standards and processes, helping to deliver excellent customer and business outcomes.

The main responsibilities for the role holder will include:

Assessing life insurance applications and claims, including complex and high-sum assured cases, by reviewing medical, financial, occupational and lifestyle information to determine risk and acceptance terms.
Supporting the development and application of underwriting philosophy, governance standards and best practice to ensure consistent, high-quality decision making.
Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, including process enhancements, automation opportunities and system developments across underwriting and claims.
Supporting capability development within the team through coaching, case reviews, knowledge sharing and feedback.
Building effective relationships with reinsurers, intermediaries and internal stakeholders, including supporting client meetings and training activities where required.
Maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements, company policies and quality standards through robust risk assessments and audit activities.

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidate will need the following skills and experience:

A minimum of 7 years' underwriting experience within the individual protection or life assurance market
Proven underwriting authority across a broad range of risk areas, including experience handling complex and high-value cases.
Strong knowledge of life assurance products, underwriting principles, risk assessment and reinsurance practices
An excellent understanding of the protection distribution market and wider industry landscape
Strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance risk management and business objectives.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with sound professional judgement
The ability to work effectively under pressure whilst maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships internally and externally
Experience supporting process improvements, change initiatives and capability development activities.
GCSE Maths and English (or equivalent) at Grade C or above.
Professional qualifications such as ACII, Dip CII, ALU or equivalent would be advantageous.
Strong Microsoft Office skills and excellent planning and organisational abilities

If you, or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position please forward your/their current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com

Our client seeks a Regulatory Compliance Officer to join their team. Role Profile: To enable the execution of Compliance Risk Management processes and activities within a specific business/functional area, to ensure that the area is undertaken in a compliant manner to avoid operational losses, fines, penalties or reputational damage to the organisation and enable the competitive advantage of the organisation. Key Responsibilities: Analyse the operational activities within a functional area to identify compliance risks and therefore ensure adherence to the relevant compliance frameworks and standards. Customise and maintain generic risk management plans (RMPs) to ensure it is appropriate within the regulatory context of a specific functional area. Proactively identify and address gaps in controls, processes and procedures as well as advise on and monitor remediation plans to address any short-comings. Review compliance training material to ensure that it is appropriate for the needs of the functional area therefore providing sufficient understanding and awareness compliance requirements within the relevant area of operations and deliver bespoke face-to-face training where required. Review compliance frameworks, standards and procedures in the context of a functional area and advise on their customisation or amendment, where necessary. The role requires an expert in Compliance with a sound knowledge of the relevant regulatory requirements and upcoming developments applicable to a specific business area as well as a solid understanding of banking products and activities. Key Skills and Qualifications: First degree in Audit, Business Commerce or Lega. l5 - 7 years in Compliance. Evaluation of Internal Controls. Financial Acumen. Legal Compliance. Process Governance. Risk Awareness. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16737

Prioritise urgent and time-sensitive client matters and ensure effective delivery.
Provide technical guidance and support to administrators and assist with team cover.

Excellent organisational, prioritisation and problem-solving skills.

Self-motivated, reliable and able to work independently with minimal supervision.

Your principal responsibilities will be managing the day-to-day affairs of the charity, supervising and supporting colleagues and volunteers, liaising with the Board, raising the profile of the charity and working with the Board to secure the charity's long-term future.

Laurence Keenan Advocates has exciting opportunities for driven individuals looking for a challenge.

Now in our 35th year, we are an established Manx firm with a reach that extends well beyond our size. Our work spans both domestic and international matters, combining the breadth of a full-service practice with the direct client relationships and agility of an independent firm.

PARALEGAL/TRAINEE ADVOCATE

An exciting opportunity for a candidate to train for the Manx Bar. You must be ambitious, hardworking, highly organised and enjoy a challenge.
Exposure to a wide variety of legal work including company/commercial, property, private client, matrimonial and litigation will be given.
The successful candidate would commence as a paralegal. Subject to satisfactory probationary period, a training contract will be offered to commence in Spring 2027. The role requires a methodical, enthusiastic and flexible individual capable of working independently while supervised by the legal team. 

If you are considering your next move, we would be pleased to have an informal and confidential conversation about the above role.

Our client seeks a Senior Client Administrator to join their team, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of clients and providing technical support to the Client Services team and management. You may be required to undertake reasonable additional or alternative duties subject to business requirements, duties include but are not limited to. Key Responsibilities Direct responsibility for a portfolio of trusts, companies and other wealth structures ensuring that excellent service levels are provided to clients to ensure longevity of relationships. Understand and act upon the profitability of the allocated client portfolio by reviewing and collecting WIP, ensuring prompt collection of fees and investigating other revenue opportunities. Work closely with clients to develop strategies that align with their goals and objectives. Be primary point of contact for clients and intermediaries. Working with other teams within the business to ensure client and business goals are met. Help to ensure the company is compliant with local regulatory requirements, supporting a positive relationship with the local regulator through strong governance. Keeping up-to-date with industry legislation and proposed changes. Drive appropriate behaviours and take action to ensure agreed business targets are met. Collaborating with and providing technical assistance to the team, offering guidance and support to team members as needed. Key Skills and Experience 5 GCSEs or equivalent. Hold or be studying towards a relevant professional qualification. Once qualified you will be expected to maintain the relevant continued professional development (CPD) hours in line with your relevant qualification and/or the requirements of the business. Previous TCSP experience in a similar role with responsibility for managing a client portfolio would be beneficial. A working knowledge of Microsoft Office, CCH, Viewpoint and Laserfiche is desirable. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16802

Manage and build the project backlog, ensuring clear and actionable requirements. Key Skills & Experience:Proven experience as a Business Analyst within digital transformation or enterprise tooling programmes.Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 applications and their business use cases. Experience in defining business processes, governance, operating models and requirements.Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, including working with business champions and senior leaders. Ability to translate business needs into structured, clear documentation and backlogs.Strong understanding of information management concepts (ownership, structure, data quality). Experience working with suppliers and internal delivery teams in a project environment. Ideally have exposure to Microsoft Copilot or similar AI enabled business tools. Experience with Azure Cloud or DevOps would be desirable.

Self-driven, results-oriented and reliable, with a positive outlook, and a clear focus on high quality service. Mature, credible and comfortable in dealing with professional people and high net worth individuals. Well-developed inter-personal skills, with an ability to motivate other administrators and interact with senior management. Self-Motivation and disciplined in task completion with the ability to resolve issues with minimum supervision. High level or organisational and prioritisation skills; flexibility and willingness to help other in a friendly and professional manner.

Excellent leadership, organisational, and communication skills. Ability to read and interpret construction drawings. Calm under pressure and solutions-focused. Full clean driving licence.

Mature, credible and comfortable in dealing with professional people and high net worth individuals. Well-developed inter-personal skills, with an ability to motivate other administrators and interact with senior management. Self-Motivation and disciplined in task completion with the ability to resolve issues with minimum supervision. High level or organisational and prioritisation skills; flexibility and willingness to help other in a friendly and professional manner.

Translating requirements and issues clearly back to the product and development teams. Supporting implementation, onboarding, training and user adoption. Experience from software/SaaS, implementation or digital transformation would be an advantage, as would previous experience in business development or sales.

Self-Employed Sales Agent – Automotive Lubricants - Part time

We are looking for a friendly, professional and motivated self-employed sales agent to promote and sell Forté lubricants—an established, market-leading range of vehicle additives and workshop consumables—to customers throughout the automotive aftermarket, including workshops, dealerships and retail outlets across the Isle of Man.

This flexible, part-time opportunity would be ideal for someone who already represents a complementary, non-competing brand or works in a similar sales role. You will manage your own time and diary, making it easy to fit the role around your existing commitments. For the right person, there is potential to develop this into a full-time opportunity.

You will be part of a friendly, relaxed and supportive working environment while retaining the independence to develop your own customer relationships and sales territory.

What we offer:
A generous 20% commission rate. 
Uncapped earning potential. 
Realistically achievable bonus structure. 
Flexible, part-time hours. 
Freedom to manage your own diary and workload. 
The opportunity to develop the role into a full-time business. 
A friendly, relaxed and supportive working relationship. 
An established range of quality products. 

About you:
Friendly, confident and comfortable speaking with customers. 
Self-motivated, reliable and well organised. 
Smart and professional in appearance. 
Contactable during normal office hours. 
Able to work independently and manage your own appointments. 
Previous sales experience would be beneficial, particularly within the automotive, workshop, motor trade or a related sector. 
An existing network of relevant customers or a complementary agency would be an advantage. 

Essential requirements:
A full, valid driving licence. 
Your own suitable transport. 
Secure and appropriate storage space for holding stock. 
The ability to operate on a self-employed basis. 

This is a self-employed, commission-based opportunity and does not include a guaranteed salary. Your earnings will be based on your sales, with no upper limit on what you can earn.

If you are enthusiastic, professional and interested in developing a flexible sales opportunity around your existing commitments, we would be pleased to hear from you.
To apply for this role please call 	07858634837

Our client seeks an experienced Senior Client Services Administrator to join their team. The ideal candidate will have proven experience of working within a regulated environment for a Corporate Service Provider and confidently manage a portfolio of asset-owning companies. This role would suit someone who is driven to continually expand their knowledge and develop their skills, contributing positively to team and client success. Key Responsibilities: Manage and administer a portfolio of corporate entities, many of which are aircraft or yacht holding. Act as a key point of contact for clients, intermediaries, government departments, registries and stakeholders. Maintain statutory records and carry out all company secretarial duties including company incorporations/dissolutions, regulatory and statutory filings, completion of annual returns, arranging and attendance at board meetings, preparing minutes and resolutions. Complete VAT registration/de-registration, review VAT returns, liaise with tax and customs advisors. Review of transactional documents and agreements, coordinate legal advice and opinions.Open and operate company bank accounts including creating, verifying and authorising payments in accordance with internal payment procedures. Assist with onboarding new business, carrying out customer risk assessments and review of CDD, perform ongoing compliance and transaction monitoring. Responsible for monitoring and controlling client WIP, raising invoices and support debt collection. Stay up to date with latest legislation and best practice in relevant areas. Attend training events and further develop relevant knowledge and skills. Support team members during periods of leave and assist with training where appropriate. Key Skills & Experience: Previous experience of managing a client portfolio within a regulated Trust and Corporate Service Provider, with full ownership and accountability for client structures and relationships. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, applying sound professional judgement to resolve problems and communicate clear, decisive solutions, escalating where appropriate. Strong communication and organisational skills. An enthusiastic, proactive and adaptable approach to work. Self-motivated with a willingness to undertake further on the job training and continual personal development. Ideally, have an understanding of business aviation and/or yachting. A second language would be an advantage. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16362

Everything we do starts with the people we serve. We’re proud to be the traders behind the tradespeople: the nuts and bolts behind the job, always ready to save the day (or at least the project).

From power tools to workwear, cables to pipe fittings, we offer over 60,000 products across 900+ stores – and that’s not to mention our industry-leading digital services. Join Screwfix and be part of a team of experts who get the job done quickly, affordably, and always with a smile.

You’ll be at the core of Screwfix, making sure our customers are the heart of everything we do. You’ll take your time to really get to know them whilst delivering genuinely great service. Our Retail Assistants are vital to the running of a store, so you’ll always be kept busy. And with the help of our excellent training programmes and varied shift patterns to support a healthy work life balance, you’ll be on the right track to develop your career. 

This is a fixed-term contract opportunity up to 6 months. 

WHAT’S IT LIKE TO BE A RETAIL ASSISTANT?

Host – you’ll welcome customers into your store, understand what they need, guide them to the right products, and make it super easy for them
Warehouse standards – you’ll assist with deliveries, maintaining product stock, collecting customer orders and keeping standards high
Part of the team – you’ll join a team who take pride in their store, work together and have lots of fun along the way!

Notes
Van Mossel Jacksons are looking for an experienced Brand Manager in premium sales of motor vehicles (BYD & Volvo) to join their dedicated team. Working within Jacksons you will be skilled and seasoned Brand Manager in the sales of our current brands of premium new and preowned vehicles.

**Some of the responsibilities for the Brand Manager position are, but not limited to;**

Engage in the art of following up with both loyal and potential customers, nurturing relationships to bring about further transactions. 
Strive to meet and exceed monthly targets for the sale of both new and used cars. 
Seek out and approach new clients with steadfast determination, arranging meetings to understand and address their needs.
Achieve monthly sales targets for New and Used vehicles, achieving the minimum profit targets.
Achieve monthly sales targets for additional profit centres including finance.
Return correspondence from customers and ensure all matters of paperwork are tended to with diligence.
Seize every opportunity to maximise sales whilst ensuring complete customer satisfaction.

**The Brand Manager position comes with an excellent remuneration and other benefits;**

Starting Salary & excellent bonus scheme
Guaranteed Income: A generous sum guaranteed for the first three months as you train and settle in the new role.
Company Car: A desirable chariot. 
Training and Accreditation: To make sure you are developed to reach the highest level of commission.

**Requirements:**
You must possess experience in the sales, a requirement without compromise.
Knowledge of the Kerridge/ADP DMS system a benefit.
The gift of clear communication, both by phone and in person, is essential.
A valid Driving Licence.
Highly presentable, ambitious and target driven, you will have a strong passion for car sales in order to meet and exceed agreed targets for the sale of vehicles and related products.

For more details and to apply contact recruitment@jacksons.je

Strand Street, Douglas, Isle of Man

Permanent | 30 hours per week
£14.52 per hour

At Holland & Barrett, we're trusted partners in helping people make health and wellness a way of life. As a Supervisor, you'll play an important role in creating an exceptional store experience by leading with confidence, supporting your team to grow and helping customers find the right products for their individual wellness journeys.

If you're passionate about people, enjoy coaching others and thrive in a fast-paced retail environment, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

Lead by example, supporting the Store Manager to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve store goals.
Coach, motivate and develop colleagues, helping them build confidence, product knowledge and deliver their best every day.
Complete our Qualified to Advise training to provide trusted health and wellness guidance to customers.
Drive sales, stock availability, visual merchandising and operational excellence across the store.
Support commercial performance through effective planning, cost control, compliance and safe working practices.
Create a positive, inclusive environment where colleagues feel supported and customers enjoy every visit.

What you'll bring

Experience in retail or customer service, with the confidence to lead and inspire others.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to build positive relationships with colleagues and customers.
A passion for health and wellness, with curiosity to keep learning and developing your product knowledge.

Notes
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented QC Analyst to join our Quality Control team. Reporting to the QC Manager, you will support manufacturing activities through the testing of raw materials, intermediates and finished products, as well as stability studies and environmental monitoring programmes.

This role plays a key part in ensuring products meet the highest quality standards while supporting manufacturing schedules, product release activities and customer commitments. You will also provide analytical support to Technology Transfer (TT), Research & Development (R&D) and other departments across the business.

The successful candidate will perform a variety of laboratory-based testing activities using approved procedures and analytical techniques, including chromatography, spectroscopy, microbiological testing and environmental monitoring of cleanrooms and purified water systems. You will maintain accurate GMP-compliant documentation, support equipment maintenance and calibration activities, manage laboratory reagents and consumables, and contribute to laboratory housekeeping and organisation.

In addition, you will support investigations relating to out-of-specification results, deviations, change controls and corrective actions, while working collaboratively with colleagues across Quality, Manufacturing and other functions. You will also be expected to support the development of colleagues through training, coaching and sharing technical knowledge where required.

To be successful in this role, you will have at least one year's experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or fine chemical industry and a good understanding of GMP principles, Quality Management Systems, pharmacopoeial requirements and ICH guidelines. Experience using techniques such as HPLC, GC, AKTA, TLC, UV-Visible Spectroscopy, titrations, bioburden and endotoxin testing is desirable, along with experience of environmental monitoring activities.

You will possess strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, particularly for preparing scientific documentation and working with cross-functional teams and external laboratory partners.

The role is primarily laboratory-based, with approximately 80% of your time spent in the laboratory and 20% undertaking office-based activities. Flexibility to support occasional overtime or weekend working may be required to meet business needs.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a quality-focused organisation where you can develop your technical expertise, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and play an important role in delivering products that meet the highest standards of quality and compliance.
Please apply via this link - https://biotage-1708019070.teamtailor.com/jobs/8333782-qc-analyst-astrea

Notes
At Astrea Bioseparations, we develop and manufacture chromatography solutions that support the purification of biopharmaceuticals worldwide. Our products play a vital role in the development and manufacture of therapies that improve and save lives.
As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Logistics Technician to join our Production team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and takes pride in ensuring materials, products and shipments move safely, accurately and efficiently throughout the business.
Working closely with colleagues across Production, Supply Chain and Logistics, you'll play a key role in supporting the smooth running of site activities and ensuring our products reach customers around the world on time.
What you'll be doing
As a Logistics Technician, you'll be responsible for the efficient movement, storage and dispatch of materials and products throughout our facility. Key responsibilities include: Receiving, unloading and processing incoming deliveries, Verifying goods against delivery documentation and reporting discrepancies,	Storing materials safely and accurately within designated warehouse locations, 	Supplying raw materials, consumables and equipment to production teams as required,	Maintaining stock accuracy through effective inventory control and stock counting activities,Picking, packing and preparing customer orders for shipment, Coordinating domestic and international shipments in line with company procedures,Preparing waste materials for collection and disposal in accordance with site requirements, Supporting warehouse organisation and housekeeping,Operating material handling equipment, including forklifts, where authorised, Following all Health & Safety, Quality and GMP requirements, Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the Operations function,
What we're looking for - We're looking for someone who is organised, dependable and enjoys working collaboratively to achieve shared goals.
Essential - Previous experience in a logistics, warehouse, stores or manufacturing support role, Good attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, Strong organisational and time-management skills,	Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team, Basic IT skills and confidence using business systems, A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Desirable - Forklift truck licence or experience operating material handling equipment, Experience working within a regulated manufacturing environment, Familiarity with inventory management or ERP systems.
To Apply, please follow this link - https://biotage-1708019070.teamtailor.com/jobs/8330828-logistics-technician-astrea
